130402.ch: 不知何故，{call|B|A}你在此境界停留许久。为师偶有际遇，寻得一{0}，此物或可助你一臂之力，望{call|B|A}你莫要辜负为师的良苦用心。
130402.en: I'm not sure why, {call|B|A}, but you've been stuck in this realm. I have been lucky enough to come across a {0}. I believe it will be of some use to you, {call|B|A}. All I ask is that you not fall short of my expectations.

130403.ch: 时隔数年，{call|B|A}你境界仍未变化，不知是否因为别有所求……但修仙一途切忌分心，这{0}你且收好，为师之言你还需谨记。
130403.en: After many years, {call|B|A}, you have not advanced beyond this realm. I'm not sure if you are occupied with some other endeavor... but one's attention cannot be split in the pursuit of immortality. I want you to have this {0}. I think you ought to keep this in mind.

130404.ch: 修仙一途凶险异常，纵使{call|B|A}你天纵奇才，也须知人外有人。这本{0}是为师精心挑选之物，你若仔细研习，实力必有大进。
130404.en: The path to immortality is treacherous and alien. Even if you are a genius, {call|B|A}, you must be aware that there are always people better than you. I have carefully picked out this {0} in the hopes that you will closely study it and that you will see marked improvement as a result.

130405.ch: {call|B|A}你独身一人闯荡八荒，始终让为师为你担忧。然近日为师寻得一本{0}，此物对你极为合适，若你苦心参悟，为师必会放心不少。
130405.en: {call|B|A}, you roam the land alone and cause your old master a great deal of worry. I have recently, however, come across this {0}. I am sure it will suit your needs well and that a careful read of it will put your old master at ease.

130406.ch: 为师知晓修仙一途危险重重，这本{0}乃是为师费尽心思所得，必将助{call|B|A}你斩妖除魔、绝处逢生，便是与同阶修仙者争衡，也绝不会落于下风。
130406.en: I know all too well the dangers of pursuing immortality. I have through some trouble managed to track down this {0}, and I imagine, {call|B|A}, that it will be of great help to you as you expunge demons and evade their savagery. It will also be of help in your competition with other cultivators.

130407.ch: 眼见{call|B|A}你突破在即，为师心中甚悦。这本{0}虽是难寻，却也堪配{call|B|A}你之天资，待你突破之后便可修炼。此物你且收好，祝你早日突破。
130407.en: I see your breakthrough is almost at hand, {call|B|A}, and I could not be more pleased. This {0} was not easy to find, {call|B|A}, but it will be of great help to someone of your talent as you achieve your breakthrough and go on to cultivate. I hope you use it well and achieve your breakthrough soon.

130408.ch: 不知不觉间，{call|B|A}你当前境界已然圆满，距离更高境界也只剩一步之遥。为师将这本{0}先行予你，你突破之后便可领悟其中奥妙。
130408.en: Just like that, {call|B|A}, your realm is complete, and a yet higher realm is not too far in the offing. I want you to have this {0}, and learn all you can from the wonders it holds.

130409.ch: 如此年纪便又将突破，你不愧是为师的好{call|B|A}！这本{0}算是为师提前为你庆祝，你突破之后专心参悟，实力必然更进一步。
130409.en: That's my {call|B|A}, making a breakthrough in an age like this! Consider this {0} an early congratulatory present. Study it well after your breakthrough, and your abilities will surely be all the better for it.

140001.en: Allow me to pay my respects, honored {call|B|A}!

140003.ch: 今日一睹{call|B|A}您的风采，弟子真乃三生有幸！
140003.en: What a joy to catch a glimpse of you here today, {call|B|A}!

140004.ch: 我{schoolName|A}未来命数，全要仰仗{call|B|A}您之威势。
140004.en: The destiny of {schoolName|A} rests on your broad shoulders, {call|B|A}.

140005.ch: 我{schoolName|A}幸有{call|B|A}您坐镇，必能屹立八荒，万年不倒！
140005.en: {schoolName|A} basks in the glory of your presence, {call|B|A}. May you stand astride the world and never fall!

140006.ch: {call|B|A}您真乃八荒才俊，羡煞我等一众弟子也。
140006.en: {call|B|A}, you are a true talent and the envy of us all.

140007.ch: 弟子若得{call|B|A}您半分天资，定能鱼跃龙门，傲视群雄！
140007.en: If I had half your talent, {call|B|A}, I could leap over the Dragon Gate and thumb my nose at the world!

140008.ch: {call|B|A}您若有闲暇，还望多多垂训我等弟子。
140008.en: If you have time, {call|B|A}, would you mind teaching us some of your moves?

140009.ch: 若有幸得{call|B|A}您的教诲，弟子死而无憾矣。
140009.en: If only you would teach me, {call|B|A}, I could die without regret.

140010.ch: 弟子今日卜得大吉，原来是会与{call|B|A}您相遇，实在妙极。
140010.en: It's my lucky day today! My fortune said I would meet you, {call|B|A}!

140011.ch: 得遇{call|B|A}，弟子今日实在造化不浅！
140011.en: It is my great fortune to meet you today, {call|B|A}!

140012.ch: {call|B|A}您德高望重，乃是宗门支柱，弟子早已仰慕多时。
140012.en: You are a mainstay of the sect, {call|B|A}! I am a long time admirer.

140013.ch: 放眼八荒各宗，何人可与我{schoolName|A}{call|B|A}您相提并论？
140013.en: When I cast my eyes across the sects of this land, who compares to {call|B|A} of {schoolName|A}?

140014.ch: 有{call|B|A}您在，我{schoolName|A}睥睨八荒，指日可待！
140014.en: Now that you are here, {call|B|A}, glory awaits {schoolName|A}!

140015.ch: 若无{call|B|A}您在，我{schoolName|A}怕是远无今日荣光。
140015.en: Without you, {call|B|A}, I fear the glory of {schoolName|A} would not be what it is.

140016.ch: 身为{school|A}弟子，最值得骄傲之事便是与{call|B|A}您身处同宗。
140016.en: The best thing about being a {school|A} Disciple is, I get to spend time with you, {call|B|A}.

140017.ch: 有朝一日我{schoolName|A}登临八荒绝顶，必然依靠{call|B|A}您的扶持。
140017.en: The day is coming when the power of {schoolName|A} will extend as far as the eye can see, and it will all be thanks to you, {call|B|A}.

140018.ch: 我{school|A}若离了{call|B|A}您，便如同出水之鱼，难以长久。
140018.en: In your absence, {call|B|A}, {school|A} would be lost, like a fish out of water.

140019.ch: 早就听闻{call|B|A}您乃我宗门支柱，今日一见，果然非同凡响！
140019.en: It is said you are the mainstay of the sect, {call|B|A}. What a great honor it is to meet you here today!

141001.ch: 原来是上宗的{call|B|A}，请受下宗晚辈一拜！
141001.en: It is Honorable {call|B|A} of the Senior Sect! Allow this humble novice of the Junior Sect to pay my respects.

141002.ch: 原来是上宗的{call|B|A}，下宗晚辈有礼了。
141002.en: Namaste, Honorable {call|B|A} of the Senior Sect!

141003.ch: 今日一睹上宗{call|B|A}您的风采，下宗晚辈真乃三生有幸！
141003.en: What an honor it is to catch a glimpse of {call|B|A} of the Senior Sect. This humble novice of Junior Sect is overjoyed!

141004.ch: 我大{schoolName|A}未来命数，全要仰仗上宗{call|B|A}您之威势。
141004.en: The destiny of {schoolName|A} rests on your broad shoulders, Honorable {call|B|A} of the Senior Sect.

141005.ch: 我{schoolName|A}幸有{call|B|A}您坐镇，必能屹立八荒，万年不倒！
141005.en: {schoolName|A} basks in the glory of your presence,{call|B|A}. May you stand astride the world and never fall!

141006.ch: {call|B|A}您真乃八荒才俊，羡煞我等一众下宗晚辈也。
141006.en: {call|B|A}, you are a true talent and the envy of all novices of the Junior Sect.

141007.ch: 晚辈若得上宗{call|B|A}您半分天资，定能鱼跃龙门，傲视群雄！
141007.en: If this humble novice had half your talent, Honorable {call|B|A} of the Senior Sect, I could leap over the Dragon Gate and thumb my nose at the world!

141008.ch: 上宗{call|B|A}您若有闲暇，还望多多垂训我等下宗晚辈。
141008.en: If you have time, Honorable {call|B|A} of the Senior Sect, would you mind showing us novices of the Junior Sect some of your moves?

141009.ch: 若有幸得上宗{call|B|A}您的教诲，下宗晚辈死而无憾矣。
141009.en: If only you would teach me, Honorable {call|B|A} of the Senior Sect, this humble novice of the Junior Sect could die without regret.

141010.ch: 下宗晚辈今日卜得大吉，原来是会与上宗{call|B|A}您相遇，实在妙极。
141010.en: It's my lucky day today! My fortune said I would meet you, Honorable {call|B|A} of the Senior Sect.

141011.ch: 得遇上宗{call|B|A}，下宗晚辈今日实在造化不浅！
141011.en: It is my great fortune to meet you today, Honorable {call|B|A} of the Senior Sect!

141012.ch: 上宗{call|B|A}您德高望重，乃是宗门支柱，下宗晚辈早已仰慕多时。
141012.en: You are a mainstay of the sect, Honorable {call|B|A} of the Senior Sect. This humble novice of the Junior Sect is a long time admirer.

141013.ch: 放眼八荒各宗，何人可与我{schoolName|A}{call|B|A}您相提并论？
141013.en: When I cast my eyes across the sects of this land, who compares to {call|B|A} of {schoolName|A}?

141014.ch: 有上宗{call|B|A}您在，我{schoolName|A}睥睨八荒，指日可待！
141014.en: Now that you are here, Honorable {call|B|A} of the Senior Sect, glory awaits {schoolName|A}!

141015.ch: 若无上宗{call|B|A}您在，我{schoolName|A}怕是远无今日荣光。
141015.en: Without you, Honorable {call|B|A} of the Senior Sect, I fear the glory of {schoolName|A} would not be what it is.

141016.ch: 身为{school|A}晚辈，最值得骄傲之事便是与{call|B|A}您身处同宗。
141016.en: The best thing about being a {school|A} Novice is, I get to spend time with you, {call|B|A}.

141017.ch: 有朝一日我{schoolName|A}登临八荒绝顶，必然依靠{call|B|A}您的扶持。
141017.en: The day is coming when the power of {schoolName|A} will extend as far as the eye can see, and it will all be thanks to you, {call|B|A}.

141018.ch: 我{schoolName|A}若离了{call|B|A}您，便如同出水之鱼，难以长久。
141018.en: In your absence, {call|B|A}, {schoolName|A} would be lost, like a fish out of water.

141019.ch: 早就听闻{call|B|A}您乃上宗的支柱，今日一见，果然非同凡响！
141019.en: It is said you are the mainstay of the Senior Sect, {call|B|A}. What a great honor it is to meet you here today!

141031.ch: 此物并非在下所需，阁下还是自己收好。
141031.en: I don't really need this. You can keep it.

141032.ch: 君子不夺人所爱，此物恕在下难以收受。
141032.en: The true gentleman does not covet his neighbor's things. I can't accept this.

141033.ch: 此等凡物在下唾手可得，你不必拿来送我。
141033.en: All things are within my reach. You don't have to offer them to me.

141034.ch: 你若觉得此物珍贵，还请自己留好。
141034.en: If you like it so much, why don't you keep it?

141035.ch: 胡乱送礼，看似慷慨，可旁人未必会领你的情。
141035.en: You can't expect people to feel grateful if you force gifts on them too eagerly.

141036.ch: 若是没点拿得出手之物，还请莫要浪费在下的光阴。
141036.en: Unless you have something good to offer, don't waste my time.

141037.ch: 在下对此物不感兴趣，还请阁下勿要多扰。
141037.en: I'm not really that interested. Please stop bothering me.

141038.ch: 非我所需之物，其本身再多贵重，对我而言也毫无用处。
141038.en: It's not something I need. Even if you found a better one, I wouldn't have any use for it.

141041.ch: 就这玩意，我看上一眼都算耽误修行！
141041.en: One look and I can tell that thing is a waste of my time!

141042.ch: 这等货色也好意思拿出来丢人现眼？
141042.en: You've got a nerve, offering me such trifles.

141043.ch: 阁下拿出此物，莫非故意引在下发笑？
141043.en: Are you trying to make me laugh?

141044.ch: 我取此物易如反掌，还用得着你来相赠？
141044.en: I can easily get my hands on one of these. There's not really much point in giving me one.

141051.ch: 你我本不必如此见外，此物非我所需，多谢{call|B|A}你一番心意。
141051.en: There's no need to give me gifts, {call|B|A}. I appreciate the gesture though.

141052.ch: 你的好意我心领了，但这东西着实不是我想要之物，{call|B|A}你自己留用便好。
141052.en: It's very kind of you, but I really have no use for it. You hang onto it,{call|B|A}.

141053.ch: 我若拒绝收受此物，{call|B|A}你不会生气吧~
141053.en: You won't be angry if I refuse, will you {call|B|A}?

141054.ch: {call|B|A}你实在太客气了，只要你像往日一般对我，便是最好的礼物了。
141054.en: There's no need to go to so much trouble, {call|B|A}. Just treat me like you always have. That would be the best gift of all.

142001.ch: 你这逆子还想如何？弑父吗？
142001.en: How dare you! You want to slay your father?

142002.ch: 你这逆子还想如何？弑母吗？
142002.en: How dare you! You want to slay your mother?

142003.ch: 虎毒亦不食子，你为何能如此狠心对我。
142003.en: Even a tiger won't eat its child. How can you be so heartless to me?

142004.ch: 残害手足之人，迟早会有报应的。
142004.en: Whoever murders their family will meet their own end in the same way.

142005.en: Husband and wife? Ha, don't make me laugh.

142006.en: Get out of my sight, you bitch!

142007.ch: 哟，这不是口口声声说要护我一世的丈夫吗？
142007.en: Well, aren't you my husband who vowed to protect me all my life?

142008.ch: 可我是你的道侣啊，你为何还要如此狠毒。
142008.en: But I'm your Partner! How can you be so cruel to me?

142009.ch: 我向来对你倾囊相授，你的“回报”可真是让我出乎意料啊。
142009.en: I never held anything back from you, and this is how you "repay" me?

142010.ch: 看来你往日对我的那些指导，不过是为了更好的毁掉我。哈哈哈，我居然还对你感激不尽。
142010.en: So you taught me all those things only to destroy me one day? What a fool I was to be grateful to you.

142011.ch: 我的道心呢……我的道心呢……
142011.en: Where is my Taoist Mind... Where is my Taoist Mind...

142012.ch: 反正我如今也是个废人了，你不如将我直接杀掉算了。
142012.en: Now that I'm a good-for-nothing, why don't you just kill me?

142013.ch: 想我堂堂一代天骄，本应前途无量。如今，全都没了……全都没了……
142013.en: I was a Heaven-chosen with a promising future. Now it's all gone... all gone...

142014.ch: 你还我道心……你快还给我……
142014.en: Give back my Taoist Mind... Give it back to me...

142015.ch: 给我一个了断吧，我不想再这么屈辱的活着了。
142015.en: Just finish me. I don't want to live a humiliated life.

142016.ch: 若是当初不招惹你，是不是我如今还能继续当我的天之骄子。
142016.en: If I hadn't messed with you, I would still live a safe and promising life.

142017.ch: 看完我的笑话了？那还不快滚！
142017.en: Have you enjoyed yourself? Get out of my sight then!

142018.ch: 从我道心被毁那日起，我就已看淡生死。你若再叫嚣，可别怪我死前拉着你垫背！
142018.en: Ever since my Taoist Mind was destroyed, life and death have lost their meanings for me. If you keep messing with me, I vow to kill you even at the cost of my life!

142019.ch: 俗话说得好，光脚的不怕穿鞋的。反正我已一无所有，就看阁下有没有勇气与我不死不休。
142019.en: As they say, he who has nothing to lose has nothing to fear. I have nothing to lose, but what about you?

142020.ch: 就算我道心被毁，你想来嘲讽我，还不够格呢。
142020.en: Even though I have lost my Taoist Mind, you are still too weak to taunt me.

142021.ch: 你一个{grade|A}的废物，还想对我落井下石。还是先掂量掂量自己有几斤几两吧！
142021.en: How dare a {grade|A} wimp like you kick me when I'm down! You overestimate yourself!

142022.ch: 不过是少颗道心而已，我即便只用一根手指头都能赢你。实在不知你何来的胆子，对我大放厥词。
142022.en: True I've lost my Taoist Mind, so what? I can bring you down with one finger. I wonder where you got the guts to taunt me.

142023.ch: {call|A|B}，你不用担忧我，我再度成为天骄不过是早晚之事。
142023.en: {call|A|B}, you don't need to worry about me. I'll rise and become a Heaven-chosen again one day.

142024.ch: 我不再是天骄了……{call|A|B}，你说我活着还有什么意义呢。
142024.en: I'm no longer a Heaven-chosen, {call|A|B}... What do I live for now...

142025.ch: 真想回到过去，我们恣意洒脱、无所畏惧。可如今，我不过是个连道心都没有了的废人。
142025.en: How I wish I could go back to the old days when we were young, free and had nothing to fear. But now I'm a good-for-nothing without my Taoist Mind.

142026.ch: {call|A|B},既然在你面前，那我就不强装平静了。我的道心被毁，如今简直悲痛欲绝。
142026.en: {call|A|B}, I won't hide my feelings before you. My Taoist Mind was destroyed, and I'm now in the depths of despair.

142027.ch: 我如今已不是天骄了，你还会待我如初吗？
142027.en: I'm not a Heaven-chosen anymore. Will you treat me the same way as before?

142028.ch: 为师如今道心已毁，实力大不如前，也无心再教导你。你若寻到更好的师父，解除师徒关系也无妨。
142028.en: My Taoist Mind was destroyed, and I'm much weaker than before. I'm not in the mood to guide you anymore. If you can find a better Master, you can leave me as you wish.

142029.ch: 多谢师父的鼓励，我会重振旗鼓，早日重塑道心的。
142029.en: Thank you for your encouragement. I will get back to my feet and recover my Taoist Mind as soon as I can.

142030.ch: 我没有道心了……我没有道心了……
142030.en: My Taoist Mind is gone... My Taoist Mind is gone...

142031.ch: 你可知我道心破碎，如今生不如死，全是拜你所赐。
142031.en: My Taoist Mind is broken, and I would rather be dead than living such a pathetic life. Do you know it's all because of you?

142032.ch: 我早已习惯了天骄的身份，可你害得我道心破碎，我日后可该如何活……
142032.en: I was used to living as a Heaven-chosen, and it's because of you that my Taoist Mind was shattered. How shall I live from now on...

142033.ch: 失去了道心，我不过也就是一个废人了。
142033.en: Without the Taoist Mind, I'm a good-for-nothing now.

142034.ch: 我不再是天骄了，简直无颜面对亲友啊！
142034.en: I'm no longer a Heaven-chosen now. My family and friends will be so disappointed in me!

142035.ch: 你喜欢什么样的女子，我这般的你可会喜欢？
142035.en: What sort of woman do you like? Will you like someone like me?

142036.ch: 外面的世界那么大，真希望你能陪我去看看……
142036.en: The outside world is vast. I really hope you can come with me to see it...

142037.ch: 我喜欢着一个人，但那人就像个榆木脑袋不开窍，都不会主动一些，难不成让我一女子先开口……
142037.en: I like someone, but person is a blockhead who doesn't take the initiative. Am I, the woman, supposed to make the first move...?

142038.ch: 如果你喜欢一个人，一定要告诉她，不要像我这般胆小……
142038.en: If you like someone you must tell her. Don't be a coward like me...

142039.ch: 我发现，我们很多喜好还挺相似的……
142039.en: I've found that we have many similar preferences...

142040.en: {call|B|A}, I haven't seen you in days. I miss you...

142041.ch: 和你在一起后，我才感受到了诸多快乐……
142041.en: Being with you has brought a lot of happiness into my life...

142042.ch: 你是我命中注定之人，遇到你之后，凛冬散尽，星河长明。
142042.en: You are my destined half. The cold winds are warmer and the stars brighter after I've met you.

142043.ch: 想牵着你的手，一起到八荒的尽头，看天长地久的风景，尝海枯石烂的味道。
142043.en: I want to hold your hand and walk with to the ends of the Earth. I want to see the skies and the land with you, and taste the spray of the ocean and rock with you.

142044.ch: 识你的第一天起，你的名字就刻在我的心底。

142149.en: {call|B|A}, I'm glad you have time to spar with me. I hope I can hang on a little longer this time…

142150.ch: {call|B|A}，今日身体有些不适，过些日子我再陪你打个尽兴，可好……
142150.en: {call|B|A}, I'm not feeling well. Let's do it some other time, okay…

142151.ch: {call|B|A}，你愿意向我索要这{0}，我很开心……
142151.en: {call|B|A}, I'm glad you're asking me for this {0}…

142152.ch: {call|B|A}，你我本是一体，我的便是你的，你愿意向我索要这{0}，我很开心……
142152.en: {call|B|A}, you and I are one, and what's mine is yours, I'm glad you're asking me for this {0}…

142153.ch: {call|B|A}，你真好，愿意陪我切磋，虽然我败了，但也得到了几分感悟……
142153.en: {call|B|A}, it's so kind of you to spar with me. I lost, but I learned a lot…

142154.ch: {call|B|A}，我居然赢了！我知道，肯定是你让着我的，对不对？
142154.en: {call|B|A}, I can't believe I won! You threw the fight, didn't you?

142155.ch: {call|B|A}，我虽然赢了，但我知道，终有一日你会将所有人打败……
142155.en: {call|B|A}, I won, but I know that sooner or later you'll be strong enough to crush everyone…

142156.ch: {call|B|A}，你我之间何以走到这一步，罢了，你要打那便打，不过是将这命还给你罢了。
142156.en: {call|B|A}, how did we get to this? Fine. Fight me if you want. Maybe it's time to give back my life to you.

142157.ch: 这{0}是我身上最贵重之物，你若还念几分旧情，可否收下放我离去……
142157.en: This {0} is the most valuable thing I have. Remember our good old days? Could you just take it and let me go…

142158.ch: 想杀便杀吧，本来这条命，在你救下我的那一刻，就该结束了
142158.en: Kill me. I should have died the moment you saved me

142159.ch: 这命本就是你救的，如今便还给你……
142159.en: You saved my life. It's time to give it back to you...

142160.ch: {call|B|A}，你想要什么我都会给你，不必这般行事……
142160.en: {call|B|A}, I'll give you whatever you want. Please don't do this…

142161.ch: {call|B|A}，你能送我东西我很开心，这{0}我便收下了，谢谢你，你真好……
142161.en: {call|B|A}, I'm thrilled that you gave this to me. I'll take this {0}. Thank you. You're very kind…

142162.ch: {call|B|A}，你能送我东西我很开心，这{0}我便收下了，谢谢你，你真好……
142162.en: {call|B|A}, I'm thrilled that you gave this to me. I'll take this {0}. Thank you. You're very kind…

142163.ch: 当年你救了我，如今我还给你……
142163.en: You saved my life. Now I'll give it back to you...

142164.en: I'm glad to have a debate with you…

142165.ch: {call|B|A}，我今日思绪颇为杂乱，不宜论道，不若过些时日，可好？
142165.en: {call|B|A}, my mind is a mess now. I don't think it's a good idea to have a debate. Do you mind if we do it some other time?

142166.ch: {call|B|A}，听你一言，多日的疑惑有了答案，谢谢你……
142166.en: {call|B|A}, it had been bothering me for days. Now I get it. Thank you…

142167.ch: {call|B|A}，你说得有道理，但和我的观点有些差异，让我回去思考一番……
142167.en: {call|B|A}, you have a good point, but it's different from how I see it. I need to think about it…

142168.ch: {call|B|A}，我还是不明白，你为何我这般对我，我做错了什么……
142168.en: {call|B|A}, I still don't get it. Why did you do this to me? What did I do wrong…

142169.ch: {school|A}能拥有{call|B|A}，必定会成为八荒第一宗门。
142169.en: Once {school|A} has {call|B|A}, it will surely become the No.1 sect.

142170.en: {call|B|A}, why is this happening to me…

142171.ch: {call|B|A}，每当月光升起，我看着天上的月亮，就会想，你是否也在想我……
142171.en: {call|B|A}, every time the moon rises, I look at it and wonder if you are missing me too…

142172.ch: {call|B|A}，我想你了,即使现在见到你还是很想你
142172.en: {call|B|A}, I miss you. Even now when I see you, I still miss you

142173.ch: {call|B|A}，当我想你的时候,你会不会也刚好正在想我。
142173.en: {call|B|A}, do you also miss me when I miss you?

142174.ch: {call|B|A}，不能陪伴你的日子里，你知道我是多么的想你……
142174.en: {call|B|A}, you have no idea how much I missed you when I was away…

142175.ch: {call|B|A}，我无时无刻不在想你，你若有空便多来找找我……
142175.en: {call|B|A}, I miss you all the time. Come and see me more often when you're free…

142176.ch: {call|B|A}，你的眼睛是星星，总是在我的夜空里悬挂着，忽闪忽闪，像飘渺的歌声，依稀的花……
142176.en: {call|B|A}, your eyes are like stars in my night sky, twinkling and flickering, like a distant song, an elusive flower…

142177.ch: 能和你在同一个宗门，我自是十分愿意的，以后，还请多多指教……
142177.en: I would love to be in the same sect as you, and I look forward to working with you…

142178.ch: 能和你在同一个宗门，我自是十分愿意的，以后，还请多多指教……
142178.en: I would love to be in the same sect as you, and I look forward to working with you…

143001.ch: {call|B|A}，能够被你亲自招纳入宗，我十分欢喜。
143001.en: {call|B|A}, I'm so glad to be introduced into this sect by you.

143002.ch: {call|B|A}，希望能够跟随你，让{school|A}更加强大。
143002.en: {call|B|A}, I hope I could follow your step and improve the {school|A} together.

143003.en: {call|B|A}, I'm happy to know you need the {0} I own. I feel I am not a nobody once someone needs my help.

143004.ch: {call|B|A}，这{0}你便拿去，若我身上其他你用得上的，也不要客气。
143004.en: {call|B|A}, take this {0}, as well as anything I own once you found they would be useful.

143005.ch: {call|B|A}，我拒绝不了你，仿佛拒绝了你，我的心就会缺了一大块。
143005.en: {call|B|A}, it would be too much for me to say no. I'll be lost if I decline you.

143006.ch: {call|B|A}，再也没有比成为你的另一半更让我幸福的事了。
143006.en: {call|B|A}, I am so fortunate to find my better half.

143008.ch: {call|B|A}，这{0}我便收下了，你送的一切我都喜欢……
143008.en: {call|B|A}, I'll take this {0}, thank you. Your gift is always delightful to me...

143010.ch: {call|B|A}，想到能够和你一同出游，感觉空气中都充满了甜味。距{0}附近不远有一福地，近日刚巧是此地最宜游览之时，我会在那等你三个月，要早点来哦~
143010.en: {call|B|A}, I'm expecting to travel with you. Imagine we take a stroll amid the balmy air... There's a great spot near {0}. Right now is the perfect time to travel there. I'll wait there for three months. Come find me soon.

143011.ch: {call|B|A}，你要什么跟我索取便可，我又岂会拒绝你。
143011.en: {call|B|A}, feel free to ask me if you want something. I'm always ready to help you.

10000001.ch: 你我之间素有嫌隙，可如今你竟想当我的义子，实在是莫名其妙。
10000001.en: You and I have often had our differences, and now you wish to be my Sworn Son? Inconceivable!

10000002.ch: 我并不愿收你为义女，望你好自为之。
10000002.en: I do not wish to take you in as my Sworn Daughter. Conduct yourself well.

10000003.ch: 此事非同小可，容我三思。
10000003.en: This is an important matter. Let me think about it.

10000101.ch: 阁下行事与我收纳义子的原则相悖，在此多费口舌也只是徒劳。
10000101.en: Your actions run contrary to my expectations for my Sworn Sons. Save your breath.

10000102.ch: 虽然你道法高深，但既与我有怨，便由不得我不拒绝你。
10000102.en: Though your powers are formidable, I have a grievance against you. I must refuse.

10000201.ch: 宿怨尚未化解之前，你我还是保持距离为好。
10000201.en: Until the grievance between us is resolved, let us keep our distance.

10000202.ch: 想结义亲是个好事，可阁下也需有些眼色。
10000202.en: To form a Sworn Bond is a good thing, but surely you know it cannot be.

10000301.ch: 我更想要一个情同手足的义兄，但恐怕我们的关系暂时无法那么融洽。
10000301.en: What I long for is a Sworn Older Brother who is like an actual brother to me. I'm afraid we are not close enough yet.

10000302.ch: 我的心结还未解开，暂时不能接受此事。
10000302.en: The knot in my heart remains. I cannot accept this for now.

10000401.ch: 与阁下以姐弟相称，可真是让人难以接受！
10000401.en: To be called Brother and Sister with the likes of you is truly quite hard to stomach!

10000402.ch: 你还企图拜我为义姐？哼！莫不是想太多了吧。
10000402.en: You want me to be your Sworn Older Sister? Hah! Perish the thought.

10000501.ch: 你未免也太过不识人情，我这般讨厌你，怎会同你做兄妹？
10000501.en: You truly have no insight into how people feel. Why would I agree to be your Sworn Sister when I dislike you so?

10000502.ch: 在下对你的反感素未隐藏过，你难道从未察觉吗？
10000502.en: I have never concealed my contempt for you. Have you not noticed?

10000601.ch: 都说父子同心，其利断金，可你我二人怕是难以同心。
10000601.en: They say that a father and son of one mind can split gold. Our minds, however, cannot be farther apart.

10000602.ch: 你这等卑劣之人，还想做我爹？难道是疯了不成？
10000602.en: I would be mad to want a rascal like you as a Father.

10000701.ch: 我的义父，定要是那种顶天立地之人，阁下还相差甚远呢。
10000701.en: My Adoptive Father must be one who towers betwixt heaven and earth. You seem to fall far short of the mark.

10000702.ch: 阁下想做我义母？可是先前我们…难道是误会？嗯…总之，这不太妥当。
10000702.en: You want to be my Sworn Mother? But earlier we... unless it was a mistake? Um... anyway, this would not be proper.

10000801.ch: 你我最好还是不要见面，免得互生怨气，乱了心神。
10000801.en: Let us refrain from seeing one another, lest our annoyances fester and disrupt our focus.

10000901.ch: 阁下怎会提出如此无理之请？我对你的厌恶果然是有道理的！
10000901.en: How could you make such an unreasonable request? I see my dislike of you is well-founded!

10001001.ch: 何人会与仇敌结为道侣？阁下莫非是在说笑。
10001001.en: Who would make Partners of their enemies? You jest!

10001101.ch: 世人皆知，道行深者为师。阁下难道不知？可真是惺惺作态。
10001101.en: Only you can be ignorant of the fact that the greater Cultivator is the Master. What pretentiousness.

10001201.ch: 阁下难道忘记了曾经的所作所为？便是你境界再高深，也休想让我折腰！
10001201.en: Have you forgotten your misdeeds? You could be a true immortal, and even that would never compel me to bow to the likes of you!

10001301.ch: 在下奉劝你，污蔑他人前请先揽镜自照。
10001301.en: I counsel you to look in a mirror before besmirching others.

10002001.ch: 哈哈哈，得遇如此高手，在下岂能交臂而失之，便是身死道消，我也想酣畅淋漓地战一场！
10002001.en: Hahaha! It would not do to let a fighter of your caliber slip past me. Though it may mean the death of me, I shall still have this fight, with nothing held back!

10002002.ch: {call|B|A}！我已忍耐你多日，纵使今日十死无生，我也要让你付出代价！
10002002.en: {call|B|A}! I have ground my teeth at the thought of you for days. Even if it means my death, I shall make you pay before the day is done!

10002102.ch: 纵是你这境界欲同我一战，我亦不惧！阁下怕是不知，我手下亡魂有多少吧！
10002102.en: To cross swords with the likes of you would be child's play. You must be unaware of the souls that have perished by my hand!

10004001.ch: 真是出乎意料，你身上竟有我寻觅已久的{0}，既然如此，岂有不拿的道理？
10004001.en: Extraordinary, that you possess the {0} which I have long sought. Thus, I have no recourse but to take it from you.

10004101.ch: 既然阁下不愿妥协，那就把往日之仇也一并做个了断吧！
10004101.en: Since you are reluctant to compromise, let us this day put an end to our vendettas, past and present!

10004201.ch: 你竟寻得此等宝物，我若不取为己用，岂不有违天理。
10004201.en: What irony, that you should come into such treasure! It is only natural that I should take it for myself.

10004301.ch: 今日偷你的{0}不过为了换些灵石，并非为了报仇，但既然被你发现了，那不如把旧账也算清楚！
10004301.en: Pilfering your {0} was for a simple exchange of Spirit Stones, not satisfaction for your past wrongs. But since I am discovered, we may as well make a clear account of everything, here and now!

10004401.ch: 卑劣之人岂配用这{0}，我今日就要用尽全力灭了你这祸害！
10004401.en: One as vile as you does not deserve this {0}. I shall rid the world of your pestilence this day!

10004501.ch: 这{0}我势在必得，你若不愿，那便来个殊死之战吧！
10004501.en: This {0} shall be mine. If you will not part with it, then let us fight to the death for it!

10004601.ch: 这{0}是救我的{relation|X|B}的重要丹药，我无论如何也要得到，话不多说，出招吧！
10004601.en: This {0} is an Elixir that will save my {relation|X|B}'s life. I shall have it by any means necessary. Enough talk. Have at you!

10006001.ch: 你我曾有嫌隙，如今又欲赠我{0}，恕在下无法放下猜忌收下此物。
10006001.en: You and I have had enmity between us, and now you wish to give me {0}? Forgive my apprehension, but I cannot accept.

10008001.ch: 想不到{0}竟在你手里，可否送我？我们也该重修一下关系。
10008001.en: I would never have guessed that you possess {0}. Could you give it to me as a balm for our relationship?

10008101.ch: 倘若你能赠与我{0}，我愿放下成见与你相处。
10008101.en: If you would gift to me this {0}, I would set aside my misgivings and entreat with you.

10008201.ch: 这{0}也许能化解我们的宿怨，阁下可愿意忍痛割爱？
10008201.en: This {0} may be sufficient for us to resolve our vendetta. Would you be willing to part with it?

10008301.ch: 你竟有这珍贵的{0}，如阁下愿赠与我，我说不定能放下往日恩怨。
10008301.en: It is astounding that you have something as precious as this {0}. If you give it to me, I may be able to set aside our differences.

10008401.ch: 虽说结仇易、化仇难，但若你能将{0}送我，或许我对你的怨气能消散不少。
10008401.en: Though it is said that it is far easier to breed enmity than to resolve it, my grudge towards you would be greatly diminished if you gifted {0} to me.

10008501.ch: 我欲借你这{0}救助他人，望阁下成全。若你愿助一臂之力，我或许会对你高看一眼。
10008501.en: I would like to come to the aid of others with your {0}. I may think more highly of you if you lent it to me.

10010001.ch: 在下并无同你切磋之意，告辞！
10010001.en: I have no desire to spar with you, and shall take my leave.

10010101.ch: 阁下道行已如此之深，不如让我开开眼，瞧瞧你这所谓的高手到底是真是假！你可敢应战？
10010101.en: It would be a real eye-opener to witness the skills of one as well-cultivated as you. Let us see if you are as good as you say!

10010201.ch: 看来阁下不过是个徒有境界，却无实力的空架子罢了。
10010201.en: It would seem that you are little more than talk, ascending illusory Realms without actual skill.

10010301.ch: 我素来看不惯你的行事风格，今日可算是解气了！哈哈哈！
10010301.en: I have often taken umbrage with your ways and means, and today I have gained my satisfaction. Hahaha!

10010401.ch: 阁下莫不是在隐藏本领？真是城府颇深！
10010401.en: Are you not hiding the extent of your abilities? What connivance!

10010501.ch: 阁下不必如此自信，小心可别阴沟里翻船，到时可就贻笑大方了。
10010501.en: Confidence floats ships, but overconfidence sinks them. Take care that you are not caught unawares.

10012001.ch: {call|B|C}，竟是你在抬价。哼！不愧是你，依旧如此可憎！
10012001.en: So you're the one who's raising the bid, {call|B|C}. As despicable as ever!

10014001.ch: {call|B|C}，与我抬价？小心明枪易躲，暗箭难防！我迟早有日会找到你的破绽。
10014001.en: You dare to outbid me, {call|B|C}? A spear in the light is more easily evaded than an arrow from the dark. One day, I will find your weakness.

10014002.ch: {call|B|C}，你这小肚鸡肠之人，竟拍卖时也要与我针锋相对！
10014002.en: {call|B|C}, you pettifogger! Going against me at every turn, even at the auction!

10014003.ch: {call|B|C}，拍卖会内不可打斗，等离开此地，我定会使劲浑身解数找你复仇的！
10014003.en: A pity that there can be no blood spilled on auction grounds, {call|B|C}, but rest assured that I shall come for my revenge!

10014004.ch: {call|B|C}，想不到你竟在拍卖时故意抬价来报复我！简直无耻至极！
10014004.en: I cannot believe that you resort to raising my bid to get back at me! Have you no shame?

10014005.ch: {call|B|C}你可知我的灵石已多如牛毛，欲与我比拼灵石，可真是不自量力！
10014005.en: {call|B|C}, you know that I have more Spirit Stones than there are stars in the sky, and still you wish to outbid me? You overextend yourself!

10014006.ch: {call|B|C}，你若执意与我相争，小心我暗下杀手！到时恐怕你一切手段都无力回天。
10014006.en: {call|B|C}, if you insist on crossing me, you would do well to watch for the knife in your back. I'm afraid nothing can bring you back from the dead!

10014007.ch: {call|B|C}，你这抬价之举，可真是符合我先前对你的评价——卑劣！
10014007.en: {call|B|C}, your petty antics to raise the bid confirms my opinion of you — imbecile!

10014008.ch: 不少高手败于低修为之人，凡事无绝对。{call|B|C}阁下以为呢？
10014008.en: Fighters far stronger than you have lost to those far lesser than me. {call|B|C}, how do you think you will fare?

10014009.ch: {call|B|C}，阁下怕是还未见识过我的手段吧？到时，可不是你修为高就能守得住这{1}。
10014009.en: {call|B|C}, I'm afraid you have no idea what I'm capable of. Your vaunted Cultivation will not save this {1}.

10014010.ch: 在下想要得到的东西，就从未失手过，{call|B|C}即使你道行深，也不见得能保住这{1}！
10014010.en: Not once have I failed at getting what I want. No matter how your Cultivation, {call|B|C}, you have already lost this {1}!

10014011.ch: {call|B|C}，阁下莫不是认为自己境界高，我就不敢下手？可真是夜郎自大。
10014011.en: {call|B|C}, did you think that the height of your ascension would give me pause? What hubris!

10014012.ch: 恶人自有恶人磨。{call|B|C}，你如此嚣张，以后指定有你好果子吃！
10014012.en: You reap what you sow, {call|B|C}. Your arrogance will eventually be your downfall!

10014013.ch: 在下道行虽浅，但找人麻烦可很在行！{call|B|C},你明白与否?
10014013.en: The depth of your Cultivation belies your ability to make trouble for others, {call|B|C}!

10014014.ch: {call|B|C}！你境界虽高，但这口袋里的灵石不见得有我多，劝你不如趁早收手！
10014014.en: {call|B|C}! You may have ascended to higher realms, but your collection of Spirit Stones is paltry compared to mine. Give up while you still can!

10014015.ch: {call|B|C}阁下的性格如此令人生厌，与其在此处花灵石找罪受，不如去坊市买点丹药防身。
10014015.en: I say {call|B|C}, with as irritating a temperament as yours, you're looking for trouble if you spend all your Spirit Stones here. You should go and buy some protective elixirs at the market!

10014016.ch: {call|B|C}，今日抬价之仇我已深记于心！假以时日，我定会让你付出代价！
10014016.en: {call|B|C}, I will remember your petty upselling act today! One day, I will make you pay!

10014101.ch: 阁下修为虽高，但若想以此威胁于我，绝非易事！
10014101.en: Your Cultivation may run deep, but I am not so easily intimidated!

1000001.ch: 久仰大名！今日一见，不甚荣幸。
1000001.en: At last we meet! It is an honor to meet you.

1000002.ch: 先前在{school|B}便听闻道友大名，今日一见，果然名不虚传！
1000002.en: They speak highly of you at {school|B}. Now that we meet, I am not disappointed!

1000003.ch: 先前在{school|B}便听闻道友大名，以你的实力，定是{school|A}的中流砥柱。
1000003.en: They speak highly of you at {school|B}. Your strength is the rock upon which {school|A} is built.

1000004.en: It is a joy to know you.

1000005.ch: 百闻不如一见，阁下果然玉树临风。
1000005.en: The stories do not do you justice, my Lord!

1000006.ch: 阁下之名，如雷贯耳！今日能当面请益，真是三生有幸。
1000006.en: Your name is known throughout the land!! What an honor it is to meet you today!

1000007.ch: 从前一直盼望能见你一面，时至今日，终于如愿。
1000007.en: I have always a hoped to meet you one day, and at long last, I receive my wish.

1000008.en: As a huge admirer, I have longed to meet you for some time!

1000009.ch: 阁下名声响亮，今日一见，才知确是名副其实。
1000009.en: Your name is resoundingly famous. Meeting you today, I see yours is a reputation well earned.

1000010.ch: 阁下对于道法极富心得，因此在下早想与您一见，好面聆教益。
1000010.en: You have formidable knowledge, and it is to learn from you yourself that I have wanted to meet you for so long.

1000011.ch: 我在八荒之中见过不少人，似阁下一般的超凡脱俗的着实少见。
1000011.en: I have met many people across the land, but very few who match your outstanding ability.

1000101.ch: 你若是在{school|A}混不下去了，便来投奔{school|B}吧！
1000101.en: If things don't work out at {school|A}, you can always come over to {school|B}!

1000102.ch: 若在{school|A}不顺心，可以考虑到{school|B}来，门为你一直开着。
1000102.en: If you are not happy at {school|A}, {school|B} will always be open to you.

1000103.ch: 即使你已加入{school|A}，我还是想将你招揽到{school|B}来。
1000103.en: I know you're at {school|A}, but I can't help trying to tempt you over to {school|B}.

1000104.ch: 以你我交情可以让你离开{school|A}加入到我{school|B}来么？
1000104.en: Could I perhaps use our friendship to lure you out of {school|A} and into {school|B}?

1001001.en: I was just thinking about you and you appeared!

1001002.en: I'm so glad I met you!

1001003.ch: 有你在身边，修道之路一点也不孤单了。
1001003.en: The Path of Cultivation isn't lonely at all with you by my side!

1001004.ch: 我们定要努力修炼，一同踏上长生之道。
1001004.en: Let's train hard and travel the road to eternal life together.

1001005.ch: 我不想一直被你保护着，我也想保护你。
1001005.en: I don't want you to protect me all the time. I want to protect you too!

1001006.ch: 有你在我身边，真的很有安全感。
1001006.en: I always feel safe when I'm with you.

1001007.ch: 最近心情有点低落，可能是我太想你了…
1001007.en: I've been feeling down lately. Maybe I've been missing you...

1001008.ch: 为何你的心情如此低落？若有心事，不妨与我说说。
1001008.en: What's wrong? If you're feeling down, you can always talk to me.

1001009.ch: {call|B|A}…我不在时，你有没有想起过我？哪怕一瞬间也好,这样我们就同时想着对方了。
1001009.en: {call|B|A}... do you miss me when I'm not around? Just a moment would be enough. That way we'll both be thinking of each other.

1001010.ch: {call|B|A}，无论何时，你一直都在我心里。
1001010.en: {call|B|A}, you are always on my mind.

1001011.ch: 本觉得人间无趣，但是我遇见了你。
1001011.en: I thought the world was boring... but then I met you.

1001012.en: I find your presence very soothing.

1001013.ch: {call|B|A}，若能一直陪伴着你，纵然前方是刀山火海，我也无所畏惧。
1001013.en: {call|B|A}, as long as you are with me, I shall fear no evil.

1001014.ch: 我会努力修炼变强，我绝不让任何人伤害你。
1001014.en: I will grow strong to protect you from all harm.

1001015.ch: 纵然万劫不复，纵然相思入骨，我也待你眉眼如初，岁月如故。
1001015.en: Though the world end, though love break my heart, I will always look upon thee with eyes of my youth.

1001016.ch: 人世间有百媚千红，唯独你是我情之所钟。
1001016.en: Though the world be filled with flowers, I only have eyes for you.

1001017.ch: 你若相邀，此生跟随，你若不离，我定不弃。
1001017.en: Invite me and I will follow. Stay and I will not stray.

1001018.ch: 在这世间总有一人在惦念你，无论何时无论何地。
1001018.en: Somebody, somewhere is always thinking about you.

1001019.en: You're the only one in the world for me.

1001020.ch: 我见道友身躯凛凛，相貌堂堂。一双眼光射寒星，两弯眉浑如刷漆。胸脯横阔，有万夫难敌之威风。能与道友在此相识，在下三生有幸。
1001020.en: When I saw you I got shivers... your noble bearing, the glint in your eye, your broad chest, your majestic presence... I can't wait to get to know you better.

1001021.ch: 道友言笑晏晏，风姿特秀，爽朗清举，笑额美人尖，那忽性之美，好似仙人下凡。能在今日与道友结识，在下倍感荣幸。
1001021.en: Your happy laughter is like the sound of a babbling brook, your graceful movements and clear, honest eyes, a beauty that takes the breath away, like an immortal descended from heaven... What an honor it is to make your acquaintance.

1001022.ch: 久仰久仰，阁下的大名早已如雷贯耳！
1001022.en: I've heard an awful lot about you. Your name is known throughout the land!

1001023.ch: 闲暇之余，不妨一同去{mapData124}的拍卖会逛逛…

1101567.en: {1} killed my {relation|X|B}. When I found them, all that was left was bones! Unfortunately I am not accomplished enough to kill {gender2|C}.

1101568.ch: {1}这卑鄙小人，竟偷袭我的{relation|X|B}，如今还躲起来！我真想把{gender|C}找出来，再杀了泄愤。
1101568.en: That sonofabitch {1} ambushed my {relation|X|B}. We still haven't found them! I'm gonna find {gender2|C} and vent my anger!

1101569.ch: {1}差点杀了我的{relation|X|B}{name|X}！所幸如今已获救，但是此仇，我决不能忍！
1101569.en: {1} nearly killed my {relation|X|B} {name|X}! Thankfully no one died, but I can never forgive what happened.

1101570.ch: 虽说我早已经知晓{1}与我的{relation|X|B}有嫌隙，但我未想到{1}竟敢痛下杀手！此仇我岂能不报！
1101570.en: I knew {1} and my {relation|X|B} had enmity, but I never thought {1} would murder anyone. How can I not seek revenge?

1101571.ch: {1}这歹人竟然向我的{relation|X|B}暗下杀手！我是不会放过{gender|C}的。
1101571.en: That thug {1} killed my {relation|X|B}! There's no way {gender|C} will get away with it.

1101572.ch: 我的{relation|X|B}险些丧命，而凶手就是{1}。我一定要杀了{gender|C}替我的{relation|X|B}报仇。
1101572.en: My {relation|X|B} almost died! {1} is responsible. I will kill {gender2|C} and avenge my {relation|X|B}.

1101573.ch: {1}杀害了我的{relation|X|B}！奈何我实力不足，无法寻仇。
1101573.en: {1} killed my {relation|X|B}! I'm too weak and cannot enact my vengeance.

1101574.ch: 我的{relation|X}如今仅剩一丝元魂，而这都是拜{1}所赐！总有一天，我除掉{gender|C}的。
1101574.en: My {relation|X} lies at death's door, all thanks to {1}! I'm going to kill {gender2|C}, one of these days!

1101575.ch: {name|C}曾试图杀害我的{relation|X|B}！此仇我决不能忍，我一定要除掉{gender|C}。
1101575.en: {name|C} tried to kill my {relation|X|B}! I must have my vengeance! I will kill {gender2|C}, one of these days.

1101576.ch: 我的{relation|X|B}被{1}杀害了，我是不会放过{gender|C}的。
1101576.en: {1} killed my {relation|X|B}. I won't let {gender2|C} get away with it.

1101577.ch: {1}真是手段狠辣，竟敢杀害我的{relation|X|B}！奈何为师近日还需处理一些作祟的妖兽，无法报仇。
1101577.en: That monster {1} killed my {relation|X|B}! I have other business to attend to and cannot seek revenge.

1101578.ch: {1}实在胆大包天，居然敢来害我的{relation|X|B}！我定不会放过{gender|C}的。
1101578.en: That {1} has got a hide, attacking my {relation|X|B}! I will never let {gender2|C} get away with it.

1101579.ch: 这{1}向来作恶多端，但我未想到此人胆敢向我的{relation|X|B}下手！真想灭掉这祸害。
1101579.en: That fiendish {1} attacked my {relation|X|B}! I'm going to kill that blight, one way or another!

1101580.ch: 这{1}竟向我的{relation|X|B}出手！这仇岂能不报！
1101580.en: That {1} attacked my {relation|X|B}! I must have my vengeance!

1101581.ch: 我的{relation|X|B}被人杀害了，虽说已被救活，但是这口气我咽不下去。
1101581.en: Someone attacked my {relation|X|B}. Nobody died, but I still can't let it go.

1101582.ch: {1}杀害了我的{relation|X|B}！但此人阴险狡诈，我几次想要击杀{gender|C}都失败了。
1101582.en: {1} killed my {relation|X|B}, that slimy, double-crossing... I can't seem to kill {gender2|C}, no matter how hard I try.

1101583.ch: 这{1}真是欺人太甚，居然向我的{relation|X|B}下杀手！奈何我实力不足，不能替我的{relation|X|B}报仇。
1101583.en: That brute {1} killed my {relation|X|B}! I'm too weak and cannot avenge my {relation|X|B}.

1101584.ch: 前些日我替我的{relation|X|B}寻仇，但却想不到{1}竟然如此难对付。
1101584.en: I've been trying to avenge my {relation|X|B} for days now, but {1} is one slippery customer.

1101585.ch: 我的{relation|X|B}被{1}杀害，我岂能不报仇！
1101585.en: {1} killed my {relation|X|B}. How can I not seek revenge?

1101586.ch: {1}竟敢对我的{relation|X|B}下手，我无论如何也不会放过此人的！
1101586.en: {1} attacked my {relation|X|B} and I cannot let it go!

1101587.ch: {1}竟企图杀害我的{relation|X|B}，那便是与我为敌，我势必要{gender|C}付出代价！
1101587.en: {1} tried to kill my {relation|X|B} and now is my enemy. {gender|C} will pay the price, I swear it.

1101588.ch: 我的{relation|X|B}惨遭{1}杀害，我怎能放过{gender|C}！
1101588.en: {1} killed my {relation|X|B}. I cannot let {gender2|C} get away with it!

1101589.ch: {1}杀害了我的{relation|X|B}，我定要与{gender|C}势不两立。
1101589.en: Since {1} killed my {relation|X|B} all I can do is think about killing {gender2|C}.

1101590.ch: {1}竟然袭击我的{relation|X|B}，实在不可饶恕！总有一日，我要除掉{gender|C}。
1101590.en: {1} attacked my {relation|X|B}. Completely unforgivable! One day I will kill {gender2|C}, once and for all.

1101591.ch: {call|B|A}，我与{0}仇深似海、不共戴天，可却始终无法将其手刃。
1101591.en: {call|B|A}, {0} is my mortal enemy. The world isn't big enough for the both of us, but I am not accomplished enough to enact my vengeance.

1101592.ch: {call|B|A}，我与{1}仇深似海、不共戴天，可却始终无法将其手刃。
1101592.en: {call|B|A}, {1} is my mortal enemy. The world isn't big enough for the both of us, but I am not accomplished enough to enact my vengeance.

1101600.ch: {call|B|A}你愿为我费心，真叫我感激不尽。
1101600.en: Thank you for going to the trouble, {call|B|A}. I really appreciate it.

1001901.ch: {call|B|A}…我不在时，你有没有想起过我？哪怕一瞬间也好,这样我们就同时想着对方了。
1001901.en: {call|B|A}... do you miss me when I'm not around? Just a moment would be enough. That way we'll both be thinking of each other.

1001902.en: You were gone so long. I missed you.

1001903.ch: 你不在的日子，我总会想你过得好不好？会不会有人伤害你？如今见你一切安好，我便放心了。
1001903.en: I always worry about you when you're not here. Then when you show up in one piece I breathe a sigh of relief.

1001904.ch: 八荒珍材汇一汤，只待今日与君尝。
1001904.en: To sup such divine soup, I can only wait for thee.

1001905.ch: 君心似我心，不负相思意。
1001905.en: May your heart be like mine, so that our love will never die.

1001906.ch: 你不在的日子，我无时无刻不在想你。
1001906.en: When you're not here, not a second goes by that I'm not thinking about you.

1001907.ch: 你的一颦一笑，你的一言一语都令我梦萦魂牵。
1001907.en: Your every gesture, your every word, haunts my dreams.

1001908.ch: 相看两不厌，朝暮共神思。
1001908.en: We gaze at each other, not growing tired, our thoughts combined from dawn to dusk.

1001909.ch: 不管以前如何，现在我的心里只有你…思你，念你。
1001909.en: No matter what happened before, you're the only one in my heart... Thinking about you, missing you.

1002001.ch: 你长得让我很不爽，下次别让我再看到你。
1002001.en: Your face really bugs me. Stay out of my way.

1002002.ch: 上次我讨伐了一只药灵，长得跟你很像。
1002002.en: You remind me of that Mushroom Man I beat up last week.

1002020.ch: 我一直觉得你很像个什么？对了，是竹妖！
1002020.en: Your magnificent beauty reminds me of something. Oh, that's right! A Bambuki!

1002021.ch: 阁下十分了得，我一看见你，就忍不住退开数尺。
1002021.en: Your greatness is such that I cannot help taking a step or two back upon seeing you in person.

1002022.ch: 我不想听见你的声音，请你离开。
1002022.en: I don't want to hear the sound of your voice. Get out.

1002023.ch: 我不想看见你，请你离开。
1002023.en: I'm sick of the sight of you. Get out.

1002024.ch: 我对你观感不佳，难道你没看出来么？
1002024.en: I haven't the best impression of you. Have you really not noticed?

1002025.ch: 看见你，我就知道接下来三个月都会气运不佳！
1002025.en: Seeing you, I know for certain that my destiny over the next three months will not be good!

1002003.ch: 你所在的{school|A}虽强，但我{school|B}也不是吃素的！
1002003.en: Your {school|A} might be strong, but my {school|B} is pretty good too!

1002004.ch: 敢得罪我，即便是{school|A}也护不住你！
1002004.en: You dare to offend me?! Not even {school|A} can protect you!

1002006.ch: 空有相貌没有实力，怕是只能成为某些人的玩物
1002006.en: Those who value only appearance and not strength are destined to become the playthings of others.

1003001.ch: 我看你是活得不耐烦了！
1003001.en: You must be tired of living.

1003002.ch: 好家伙，我倒要看看你到底有何本事！
1003002.en: Dude, show me what you can do!

1003003.ch: 此处山清水秀，风水俱佳，道友莫非想埋骨于此？
1003003.en: The scenery is beautiful and the fengshui is auspicious. Could it be you want to be buried here?

1003004.ch: 来得好！我正想找你呢！今日，不是你死便是我亡！
1003004.en: Yes! I was just thinking about you! Today it's either me or you!

1003005.ch: 今日正是黄道吉日，合该将你挫骨扬灰！
1003005.en: Today is a good day—garbage day!

1003006.ch: 若要今后能够安睡，今日必须将你杀死！
1003006.en: I will never sleep soundly if I do not kill you today!

1003007.ch: 哼，今日既分胜负，亦决生死！来吧！
1003007.en: Hmph. We will see who walks away the victor and who never walks again!

1010002.ch: 呸！记住你了，给我当心点！
1010002.en: Pah! I know you! Don't you dare!

1010003.ch: 今日之辱，来日我必将加倍奉还！
1010003.en: Today's insults will be repaid with interest!

1010004.ch: 算你识相，我身后可是你一辈子都惹不起的人！但今日之事还不算完，你给我等着！
1010004.en: Smart choice. I have friends in high places, people you don't want to piss off! This isn't over, not by a long shot!

1010005.ch: 现在放走我，来日你可要大大的后悔！
1010005.en: Let me go, and I promise you will regret it!

1010006.ch: 事先声明，如果以后是我占了上风，是绝不会放过你的！
1010006.en: Hear me now. If later I should be the more fortunate, I would not let you off!

1010007.ch: 我一定会记住阁下今日所赐，日后亦必十倍奉还。
1010007.en: I will not forget this gift, good person, and I will be sure to pay you back tenfold someday.

1010101.ch: 我宁可死于战场，也不会低头求饶！要杀便杀！
1010101.en: I would rather die in battle than beg for mercy! Kill me, I don't care!

1010102.ch: 要杀便杀，莫要羞辱于我！
1010102.en: Kill me, but don't humiliate me!

1010103.ch: 我绝不会屈服于你，赶紧给我一剑！
1010103.en: I will not surrender to you! I'll have the sword!

1010104.ch: 我只要站着死，决不跪着生！
1010104.en: I'd rather die on my feet than live on my knees!

1010105.ch: 不要废话，赶紧杀了我，宁死不降！
1010105.en: Don't be absurd. Hurry up and kill me now! I'll die before I surrender!

1010201.ch: 好！从今日起，{name|C}便是我的弟子了！
1010201.en: Excellent! From this day on, {name|C} shall be my Disciple!

1010301.ch: {name|C}恐怕不适合成为我的弟子，还望{call|B|A}三思。
1010301.en: I'm afraid {name|C} won't be a good Disciple for me. Please think it over, {call|B|A}.

1010401.ch: {call|B|C}与我之间有些隔阂，我不愿意成为{gender|C}的弟子，还望{call|B|A}三思。
1010401.en: {call|B|C} and I don't really see eye to eye. I don't want to become {gender1|C} Disciple. Please, {call|B|A}, think it over.

1010601.ch: 既是你亲自邀请，那么我便加入{0}吧！
1010601.en: Since you invited me yourself, I'll gladly join {0}!

1010602.ch: 若是与你在同一宗门，想想倒也挺美好的，那我就应了此事。
1010602.en: Thinking about it, being in the same sect sounds like a good idea. I'll do it.

1010603.ch: 正好我如今也无宗门，我们夫妻俩在同宗门也好互相有个照应。
1010603.en: As it happens, I don't have a sect either. If we're in the same sect, we'll be able to keep an eye on each other just as well.

1010604.ch: 既是你亲自邀请，那么我便加入{0}吧！
1010604.en: Since you invited me yourself, I'll gladly join {0}!

1010611.ch: 虽说我如今的宗门倒也不错，但若能与你在同宗门自然更好。
1010611.en: My current sect is pretty good, but if I can be in the same sect as you, of course that would be even better.

1010612.ch: 既然{call|B|A}想邀我与你在同一宗门，那我自然不会拒绝。
1010612.en: Since it is you who is asking, {call|B|A}, how could I possibly refuse?

1010701.en: Sorry, I don't want to join {0}.

1010702.en: I'm not ready to join a sect.

1010711.ch: 人各有志，{0}并非我心所愿，还望阁下理解。
1010711.en: Everyone is different. {0} isn't really what I want. I hope you can understand.

1010712.ch: 以我的资质，做个散修岂不是更逍遥快活。
1010712.en: In my experience, Rogue Cultivators don't have it that easy.

1010721.ch: 我早已适应了如今所在的宗门，再做更换实在繁琐。
1010721.en: I'm used to where I am. Changing sects again will be too much trouble.

1010722.ch: 虽说我也想与你日日相见，但我如今所在的宗门的确更为合适。
1010722.en: I'd like to see more of you too, but I am happy with my current situation.

1010723.ch: 既然你我已是夫妻，那我便直言了，我并不愿加入{0}。
1010723.en: Since we're already married, I'll be straight with you. I don't want to join {0}.

1010731.ch: 我并不愿与你有过多接触，恕我不能应你此事。
1010731.en: I think we already see enough of each other. I'm afraid I can't accept.

1010732.ch: 有你在的宗门，想必污浊不堪，我可不愿加入。
1010732.en: The sect would be so nasty with you there. There's no way I'm joining.

1010733.en: Sorry, I don't want to join {0}.

1010801.ch: 今日我欲将这<r>{taoistHeart|A}</r>之道传授于你，你可愿接受？
1010801.en: I'd love to teach you the <r>{taoistHeart|A}</r> today. Do you want to learn it?

1010901.ch: 既然你愿将<r>{taoistHeart|A}</r>所凝之种传授于我，我绝不会辜负{call|B|A}你的期望，今后定会努力贯彻<r>{taoistHeart|A}</r>之道。
1010901.en: Since you want to impart seeds of the <r>{taoistHeart|A}</r> to me, I don't see how I can refuse you, {call|B|A}. Henceforth I will put the <r>{taoistHeart|A}</r> to good use.

1011001.ch: 多谢{call|B|A}美意…只是这<r>{taoistHeart|A}</r>并非我所追求之道，恕我拒绝。
1011001.en: How kind of you, {call|B|A}... But this <r>{taoistHeart|A}</r> is not the path that I am looking for. Please accept my apologies.

1011102.ch: 成功从{name|B}处获得了<r>{taoistHeart|B}</r>的传承。

1011201.ch: 今日我欲将这<r>{taoistHeart|B}</r>之道传授于你，你可愿接受？
1011201.en: I'd love to teach you the <r>{taoistHeart|B}</r> today. Do you want to learn it?

1011301.ch: 是否消耗50精力，潜入领地掠夺资源？
1011301.en: Raid the territory at the cost of 50 Stamina?

1011401.ch: 你这样抢劫东西迟早会遭报应的
1011401.en: One day, you will pay for this!

1011501.ch: 既然你已经败了，那就留下来帮我看守三个月吧
1011501.en: Since you lost, I'll keep you as my servant for 3 months.

1011601.ch: 既然你们宗主愿意用资源将你赎回，那你就滚吧
1011601.en: Your Sect Leader paid the ransom. Now get out of here!

1011701.ch: 两个月后全体进攻！努力抢下资源点！
1011701.en: The full-out attack is in 2 months to take the resource point!

1011801.ch: 宗门正在进攻资源点，宗门弟子速速前往！
1011801.en: Your sect is attacking a resource point. All disciples are requested to head over!

1011901.ch: 宗门资源点在被进攻，宗门弟子速速前往！
1011901.en: Your sect's resource point is under attack. All disciples are requested to head over!

1012401.ch: 资源点原归属宗门已经不存在或离开本州，我方直接占领了。
1012401.en: The sect that once owned the resource point no longer exists or has left the region. Resource node captured.

1012501.ch: 我宗部队进攻了领地，获得了胜利，增加了一块领地。
1012501.en: Your sect attacked and occupied a new territory.

1012701.ch: 我宗部队进攻了领地失败，未能获得领地。
1012701.en: Your sect attacked a territory but failed to occupy it.

1012801.ch: 我宗没有守住领地的入侵，丢失了一块领地。
1012801.en: Your sect failed to defend a territory and lost it.

1012901.ch: 宗主，刚刚发现一块领地可以攻击，是否要进攻？
1012901.en: Sect leader, we found a territory within our reach. Do you want to attack it?

1013001.ch: 出于宗门发展考虑，决定两个月后进攻资源点，由你带领弟子主持进攻。
1013001.en: With the Sect's development in mind, it has been decided that we will attack this Resource Point in two months' time. You shall lead the assault.

1013101.ch: 出于宗门发展考虑，决定两个月后进攻资源点，由你将跟随参与进攻。
1013101.en: With the Sect's development in mind, it has been decided that we will attack this Resource Point in two months' time. You shall join the assault.

1013201.ch: 想不到防守如此松懈，竟然无人在此，真是幸运啊！
1013201.en: I can't believe defense is so lax that they have no one here. What luck!

1013301.ch: 劫掠资源点或会掀起争端，你是否要这样做？（消耗50精力）
1013301.en: Looting a resource point may start a dispute. Are you sure you want to do this? (Costs 50 Stamina)

1013501.ch: 哼，竟还要我伺候你这个手下败将！
1013501.en: How dare you ask to have me serve a vanquished warrior!

1013601.ch: 我倒没想到，你们宗主还舍得花价码将你赎回去啊！
1013601.en: I did not think that your Sect Leader would bear to pay the price to get you back!

1013701.ch: 此次进攻资源点，许胜不许败！
1013701.en: We will take the resource point this time! There is only victory!

1013801.ch: 已发起对资源点的进攻，门中弟子都应尽力，请速速前往！
1013801.en: We've launched the attack on the resource point. All disciples must do their best! Hurry!

1013901.ch: 敌方大举来攻，请门内弟子急速救援！
1013901.en: The enemy is attacking in force. Please send disciples to lend support as soon as possible!

1014001.ch: 了不起，竟然一举攻下了资源点了！
1014001.en: Impressive. They took over the resource point in one fell swoop!

1014101.ch: 可惜可惜！差点就能拿下资源点！
1014101.en: What a pity! We almost took the resource point!

1014201.ch: 若非有你助阵，岂能轻易守住资源点？
1014201.en: We wouldn't have been able to hold it so easily if it weren't for your help.

1014401.ch: 此资源点就此丢空，着实浪费，倒不如由我们经营起来。
1014401.en: It will be a waste to lose this resource point. We should operate a business instead.

1014501.ch: 此次我宗参战人员个个都是精英，因此顺利拿下领地。
1014501.en: All the participants from our Sect were elites this time, so we took over the territory easily.

1014601.ch: 因为防守得法，最终宗门守住了领地。
1014601.en: The Sect eventually held the territory because of good defense.

1014701.ch: 我宗于进攻领地的行动中失利，未能将之拿下。
1014701.en: My Sect lost in the attack on the territory and failed to take it.

1014801.ch: 敌人大举来犯，我们没能抵挡住进攻，这块领地保不住了。
1014801.en: The enemy came in force and we could not resist the attack. This territory is lost.

1014901.ch: 该处领地由我带同弟子即可攻下，不知宗主意下如何？
1014901.en: I can take this territory with my fellow disciples. What do you think, Sect Leader?

1015001.ch: 此资源点若不拿下，必成我宗腹心之患，请你主持大局，攻下据点。
1015001.en: If we don't take this resource point, it will become a great disaster for our Sect. Please keep the big picture in mind and take the strategic point.

1015101.ch: 资源点是宗门命脉，两月后，请你参与到大部队去一起攻打这个资源点。
1015101.en: The resource point is the lifeblood of the Sect. In two months, please join the main forces to attack this resource point together.

1015201.ch: 你是否要对资源点进行掠夺？（消耗50精力）
1015201.en: Do you want to raid the resource point? (Costs 50 Stamina)

1015301.ch: 岂有此理！下次再来我剁掉你的手！
1015301.en: How dare you! I will chop off your hand if you come again!

1015401.ch: 不要动什么歪心思，我会一直盯着你！
1015401.en: Don't get any funny ideas! I have my eyes on you!

1015501.ch: 把你放回去，只是因为我们不愿意再为你浪费口粮！
1015501.en: We put you back because we didn't want to waste any more food on you!

1015601.ch: 拿下资源点，宗门未来可期，请诸位尽力！
1015601.en: Our Sect will have a promising future if we take this resource point. Let's all do our best!

1015701.ch: 此次我宗必须攻下资源点，请各位尽力！
1015701.en: We must take the resource point this time! Everyone, let's give it our all!

1015801.ch: 事关宗门存亡，一应弟子都应努力防守！
1015801.en: The survival of the Sect is at stake! All disciples, do your best to defend it!

1015901.ch: 此战胜得漂亮，但之后仍需仰赖各位要努力守护。
1015901.en: A beautiful victory. We shall still rely on you afterwards to do your best to defend it.

1016001.ch: 此回虽败，但来日仍有机会，各位不必灰心！
1016001.en: We lost this time, but we will have another chance in the future! Don't lose heart, everyone!

1016101.ch: 我就知道有你坐镇，定能守住资源点。
1016101.en: I knew the resource point could be guarded with you at the helm.

1016301.ch: 该资源点物资十分丰富，我们要好好经营一番才是。
1016301.en: The resource point is rich in supplies so we should do our best to manage it as a business.

1016401.ch: 才一交锋，我们便攻破对方防守，领地眼下已归入我宗版图。
1016401.en: We broke through the opponent's defense as soon as we clashed, and the territory is now our Sect's territory.

1016501.ch: 敌人攻势都被我方巧妙化解，宗门由此守住。
1016501.en: We cleverly neutralized the enemy's attack, and the Sect is defended.

1016601.ch: 敌方防守严密，于进攻行动中，我们未能取得胜利。
1016601.en: The enemy's defenses were so tight that we could not achieve victory in the attack.

1016701.ch: 敌宗部队空巢而出，攻破我们防线将领地夺去！
1016701.en: The enemy sect swarmed out of their nest, broke through our defenses, and took the territory!

1016801.ch: 属下请命，希望带同弟子前往拿下{defendName}{eventName}，盼宗主成全！
1016801.en: Give me command, Sect Leader. I will lead the disciples to take the {defendName}{eventName}!

1016901.ch: 敌人狼子野心企图借此资源点蚕食我宗，请各位赶走对手，保护宗门！
1016901.en: The enemy is ambitious in trying to use this resource point to take over our clan. Drive away the opponents and protect the sect!

1017001.ch: 这个资源点宗门志在必得，务必请你亲身前往击退防守敌人。
1017001.en: The Sect is determined to win this resource point, so I must ask you to go forth personally and repel the defending enemy.

610102.en: The scripture holding a Secret Technique belonging to {0} got stolen by {1}. Please retrieve it for us immediately.

610103.ch: 嗯…这的确是我{0}。这是给你的奖励，请收下吧。
610103.en: Hmm... this is indeed the Secret Technique belonging to {0}. Here's your reward.

610104.ch: 你想要狩猎{0}？{0}可是{1}强者，切勿大意。
610104.en: You're here to hunt {0}? {0} is considered very powerful in {1}, so you'd better be careful.

610106.ch: 竟敢擅自盗取我的东西，真是好大的胆子！
610106.en: How dare you steal from me?

610107.ch: …哼！你若确实想要，倒也不是不行。只是，你必须要替我去完成一件事情。
610107.en: ...Well, if you really want it, I could just give it to you... as long as you complete a task for me first.

610108.ch: 将我的遗物交给我的{1}{2}，剩下的东西便全送给你了。
610108.en: Please bring my remaining belongings to my {1}, {2}. You can have the rest.

610109.ch: 好！我给你{0}的时间，你若是没有及时将东西送给{1}，我绝不放过你！
610109.en: All right. I'll give you {0}. If you don't bring the item to {1} before that, I'll make sure you never hear the end of it!

610110.ch: 不识好歹！既如此，今日我便让你埋葬于此！
610110.en: You're truly a foolish one. I guess I'll have to make sure you don't leave this place alive!

610111.ch: 背信弃义的家伙，今日我便要让你付出代价！受死吧！
610111.en: Filthy traitor, you will pay today! DIEEEE!!!

610112.ch: （{0}似乎就在附近，要上前和{0}对话吗？）
610112.en: (Looks like {0} is nearby. Would you like to talk to {0}?)

610114.ch: 没想到时隔多日还能收到{0}的遗物，有劳你了。
610114.en: Didn't expect to receive {0}'s belongings after so long. Thanks for coming all the way.

610115.ch: {0}！没想到竟是你这无耻之徒！我都死了你还不肯放过我，今日我定要将你碎尸万段！
610115.en: {0}! How could you, shameless scoundrel? I'm already dead, yet you would not leave me alone. Watch me rip you to shreds today!

610116.en: It can't end like this... it can't!

610117.en: {0}, didn't expect it to be you...

610118.ch: 唉，既然是你，那么便将我生前所留之物一并带走吧…
610118.en: Well, if it has to be you, then please at least take my remaining belongings with you...

610119.ch: 只是我有一个请求…我虽已身死，但是我最恨的人{0}还活着…{0}一日不死，我便一日无法安息！你…你能否替我报仇？
610119.en: I have one request, though... I may be dead, but {0}, my nemesis, is still living. I can't rest easy knowing that {0} is still around! Can you... avenge me, please?

610120.ch: 那么就算了吧…很高兴能够再次遇见你，我也是是时候该上路了，保重…
610120.en: Forget it, then. I'm glad to have had the chance to meet you once more. Well, it's time I go on my way. Take care, friend.

610122.ch: 终于是帮{0}报得了此仇…此事终于告一段落了。
610122.en: Finally avenged {0}... This whole affair is over at last.

610123.ch: （似乎是一座孤坟，要不要过去看看？）
610123.en: (Looks like a solitary grave. Should I take a closer look?)

610124.ch: 谢谢你愿意替我报仇…那么我便安心上路了，来世再见…
610124.en: Thank you for promising to avenging me... I can go on my way with my mind at ease now. May we meet in our next life.

610125.ch: （前方似乎埋藏着一些宝藏，要过去看看吗？）
610125.en: (Looks like some more treasure is buried up ahead. Should I get a closer look?)

610126.ch: 年轻人，先不要急着走…到{positionName|1001}来一趟，我有好东西要交给你。
610126.en: Hey, young'un! What's the hurry? Come over to {positionName|1001}, I've got something good for you.

610127.en: Who in the world are you?

610128.ch: 嘿嘿！年轻人，不要心急…来了便知。
610128.en: Heh, don't get your underpants in a twist, young one. Just come and you'll know.

610130.ch: 前辈唤我来此，所为何事？
610130.en: Why have you summoned me here?

610131.ch: 嘿嘿嘿~我且问你，上古神器{artifactName}是否在你手中？
610131.en: Heh, let me ask you... Do you have the ancient artifact, {artifactName}?

610132.ch: 哈哈哈，果然没错！把你叫过来，是有一个东西想要交给{artifactName}的主人。
610132.en: Aha, I knew it! See, I have something I want the owner of {artifactName} to have.

610133.en: Come with me into the Tree Vault.

610134.ch: 哈哈哈，不要这么警惕嘛！我不过是想将一样东西交给{artifactName}的主人。
610134.en: Come on, no need to be on your guard. All I want is to give a little something to the owner of {artifactName}.

610135.en: Come with me into the Tree Vault.

610136.ch: 年轻人，你可曾听闻过建木之名？这可是八荒世界中最巨大且最为神秘的古树！在上古的鸿蒙时期，就已经有建木的存在了。
610136.en: Have you heard of the Tree Vault, young one? They're the largest, most mysterious old trees in the world. They've been around since the world was first born from chaos.

610137.ch: 今日，我便将这建木空间的部分使用权交给于你。你可以将多余的物品暂存于建木之中，待到需要之时再将其取出。
610137.en: Today, I'm granting you access to some of the space in the Tree Vault. You can store excess baggage here and take it out when you need it.

610138.ch: 你可以在八荒世界的许多地方寻找到建木的踪迹，建木的所有树根与枝干都是相通的，你可以在任意一处建木的树根中取得你所寄存的物品。
610138.en: You can find Tree Vaults in multiple locations in the world. The roots and branches of these trees are all linked, so you can store your items in one Tree Vault and retrieve them in any other Tree Vault.

610139.ch: 对了，你所收集到的多余的书籍，也可以存入建木的书库中，日后在闲暇之余不妨查阅一番。
610139.en: By the way, any books you collect can be stored in the Tree Vault Library to be read later.

610140.ch: 好了，该交代的事情我也交代得差不多了…有缘再见。
610140.en: All right, I think I've told you all you need to know. May we meet again someday.

610141.en: ({name|B} seems to have something to say to me.)

610142.ch: 这位道友，若无要事，可否帮我一个忙？
610142.en: Hey over there! Do you have some spare time to lend me a hand?

610143.ch: 与我相伴多年的灵宠突然走失…我找寻多日，却一直没有发现它的踪迹。
610143.en: My spiritual pet that's been my companion for years has gone missing... I've been searching for days but can't find it anywhere.

610144.ch: 道友，你能帮我找找吗？它应该就在附近…你若是能帮我寻回灵宠，我必有重谢！
610144.en: Can you help me search, my friend? It can't have gone far... I'll pay you handsomely if you find it, of course!

610145.ch: 好吧…既然如此，那我也不勉强。
610145.en: All right... In that case, I won't force you.

610146.ch: 它是一只大公鸡，长得十分漂亮，就是脾气有些大…
610146.en: It's a large rooster. Quite pretty, but rather temperamental.

610147.ch: 多谢道友！它一定就离此地不远，可我寻了多日却没有发现丝毫线索…只能劳烦道友了。
610147.en: Thanks a lot, friend! It can't have gone far, but I've searched for days and still nothing. Your help is really appreciated.

610149.ch: 啊！没想到你真的找回了我的大公鸡！
610149.en: Whoa! You found my big rooster!

610150.ch: 大恩不言谢，这里的{0}便送给道友作为谢礼了！日后若是有需要我帮忙的地方，尽管开口！
610150.en: I'm very grateful. Here, take this {0} as reward. Do come see me if you ever need help in the future!

610151.ch: 大恩不言谢，虽然我非常想报答你，但我现在身无分文…
610151.en: I'm so grateful. I'd love to repay you, but I have no money on me right now...

610152.ch: 来日，我定会报答你的大恩大德！
610152.en: I'll be sure to repay you someday in the future!

610153.en: Would you like to return {0} to {1}?

610154.ch: 小家伙，修炼遇到瓶颈了吧？别着急，我有一枚仙丹，定能助你一举突破至炼气中期！
610154.en: Young one, have you encountered a bottleneck in your cultivation process? No worries, I've got a spiritual pill that'd help you break through to the Qi Refining Middle stage in one go!

610155.ch: 嘿嘿嘿~我这<g>聚气丸</g>，在寻常的坊市中，能卖到800灵石的天价！关键是有价无市，即便你身缠万贯，还不一定能买得到呢！
610155.en: Heh, this <g>Qi Refining Pill I</g> I've got here could go for 800 Spirit Stones in your average market—but it's so rare that not even a billionaire could always obtain one if he wanted to!

610156.ch: 但是，我见你天生骨骼惊奇，是万中无一的修道奇才！既然你我有缘，我又有心想要助你一臂之力…这原价800灵石的<g>聚气丸</g>，现在只需要400灵石我便转让给你。你意如何？
610156.en: Anyway, judging from your form and posture, I know you're a talented, one-in-a-million cultivator. Since fate has brought us together, I'd like you to have this <g>Qi Refining Pill I</g> worth 800 Spirit Stones for just 400 Spirit Stones. What do you think?

610157.ch: 嘿嘿嘿~果然够爽快，这枚<g>聚气丸</g>是你的了！
610157.en: Heh, I know you're a smart one. This <g>Qi Refining Pill I</g> is all yours now!

610158.ch: 啧…不识好歹，不买就拉倒！我还不想卖呢！
610158.en: Tch, what a fool. You don't deserve my wares anyway.

610160.ch: 不用太为我费心，我能照顾好自己。
610160.en: No need to worry about me. I can take care of myself.

610162.ch: 不用太为我费心，我能照顾好自己。
610162.en: No need to worry about me. I can take care of myself.

610165.en: ({name|B} seems to have something to say to me.)

610166.ch: 这位道友，你似乎…并非云陌州之人啊！莫非刚来此地不久？
610166.en: Hello there. Doesn't look like you're from Yun Mo! Are you new?

610167.ch: 唉…你来得可真不是时候。
610167.en: Ah... You've chosen a really bad time to visit.

610168.ch: 近年来，云陌州中的正道势力与妖修的争斗愈发激烈…若是被卷入其中，稍有不慎便会万劫不复。
610168.en: In recent years, the righteous faction and the Untamed in Yun Mo have been feuding constantly. If you get caught in the crossfires by accident, you could very well end up dead.

610169.en: (Looks like there are people fighting up ahead...)

610170.ch: 你们这帮妖魔，还不快快束手就擒！

610171.ch: 可恨，你们正道之人就会以多欺少！今日即便我等在劫难逃，也绝不会屈服！
610171.en: You so-called "righteous ones" are none but a bunch of big bullies! Even if we're doomed, we would never surrender to you!

610174.ch: 这些妖魔并非人类，却伪装成人类的样子，着实可恶！
610174.en: These demons aren't humans, even though they may pretend to be. Bunch of rascals...

610175.ch: 如此一来，我们的任务也告一段落了。就此别过，有缘再会！
610175.en: Our mission here is done now. Farewell and may we meet again!

610176.ch: 这位朋友，感谢你愿意出手相助！若不是你，今日我等恐怕在劫难逃。
610176.en: Thank you for lending us a hand, friend! If it weren't for you, we'd be dead by now.

610177.ch: 我们虽与常人有异，但却从未做过伤天害理之事！这些所谓的名门正道，不知为何非要将我们赶尽杀绝。
610177.en: We may not look like ordinary humans, but we've never done anything bad! Yet these so-called "righteous ones" are out for our blood for some reason.

610178.ch: 我不能在此久留，这些东西是我从他们手中得到的，便赠于你吧！我们必须离开此地了，后会有期。
610178.en: We can't stay here for long. I've obtained these from those guys. They're all yours now! It's time for us to leave. May we meet again!

610179.ch: 嘿嘿！这位朋友，你可知道正道之人为何要刻意针对那些半人半妖的家伙嘛？
610179.en: Hey there! Do you know why those righteous ones hate the Untamed so much?

610180.ch: 我这里有一些小道消息。你若是感兴趣，可愿用<g>500灵石</g>来换取？放心！绝对不会让你失望的！
610180.en: I've heard a few rumors about that. If you're interested, you can pay <g>500 Spirit Stones</g> and I'll spill. You won't be disappointed, I promise!

610183.ch: 据说，这些家伙体内的妖族血脉似乎还有些来头！他们人数虽少，却能在云陌州中与那群正道的王八蛋抗衡这么多年，你可知这是为何？
610183.en: I've heard that these Untamed actually have an interesting background. They're few in numbers but they've stood firm against those so-called righteous ones in Yun Mo for years, which means they must be very skilled. Do you know the reason behind that?

610184.ch: 他们修为不弱，再加上强大的妖魔血脉，让他们的实力提升了不止一个档次！
610184.en: They're a decently cultivated bunch with powerful demon ancestry. Of course they're on an entirely different level!

610185.ch: 特别是他们的首领风允婼，虽然此人极其神秘，有关于他的情报少之又少。但有一点却是可以肯定的，整个云陌州中，绝无一人能与他为敌！
610185.en: Especially their leader, Feng Yunchuo. Quite the mysterious one, no one knows much about him—except that he's the most powerful of all in the entire Yun Mo!

610186.ch: 更详细的我就不知道啦！这群半人半妖的家伙的大本营就在云陌州的西南方，你若是不想死于非命，最好不要随便接近。
610186.en: That's pretty much all I know. You can find the headquarters of the Untamed in southeast Yun Mo, but I wouldn't suggest you to head there unless you're asking to be killed.

610187.ch: 唉…能让正道之人付出这么大的代价也要得到的东西，只怕不会那么简单呀！
610187.en: Clearly they're in possession of something powerful... something those righteous ones would pay any price to get their hands on!

610188.ch: 对了…先前风允婼被各大正道宗门中的高手联手围攻，最终妖人们力压正道宗门，取得了胜利。
610188.en: Oh, right, I remember the elites of the righteous sects once ganged up on Feng Yunchuo, yet the Untamed still ended up victorious.

610189.ch: 但是风允婼的家眷似乎在撤离时遭遇暗算，他的女儿似乎被刺客给掳走了…
610189.en: However, while retreating, Feng Yunchuo's family was ambushed, and an assassin abducted his daughter.

610190.ch: 风允婼是一定不会善罢甘休的。咱们啊，就等着看好戏吧！
610190.en: Feng Yunchuo wouldn't let them go that easily! Let's just wait and see what happens!

610191.en: ({name|B} seems to have something to say to me.)

610192.ch: （这个气息…似乎有什么东西要过来了。）
610192.en: (I sense a change in the air... Something's approaching.)

610193.ch: 快…快让开！不想死，就别拦着我！
610193.en: O-out of my way! Don't block my path unless you're asking for death!

610194.ch: （此人气息紊乱，似乎已经身受重伤…）
610194.en: (Judging from his trembling breaths, this guy must be mortally wounded...)

610195.ch: 这位道友，你刚才可有见到一名受伤的男子？
610195.en: Hello there. Did a wounded man pass by here?

610196.ch: 他外表形似人类，其实是一个杀人不眨眼的妖魔！我等奉命星夜追杀至此，还希望道友能告诉我那妖魔的去向。
610196.en: He may look like a human, but he's actually a demon and murderer! We're sent by Starnight here to capture him. Please tell me where he's gone.

610199.ch: 哼！果不其然，你果然是妖魔的同党！今日，你必死无疑！
610199.en: Ugh, I knew it, you're one of them! You die today!

610201.ch: 多谢这位道友出手！我们已追寻这妖魔多日，却还是差点让他逃了。
610201.en: Thanks for the help, bud! We've been pursuing this demon for days, and he nearly escaped yet again.

610202.ch: 此物便赠于道友，以表心意。我们还有任务在身，便不在此久留了…再会！
610202.en: Here's a little something for you. We've got something else on our agenda, so we've gotta go. See you!

610203.ch: 哈哈哈，想不到你这小畜生竟会落入我手中！
610203.en: Ha, didn't expect this, huh? You're all mine now!

610204.ch: 这么多年来， 我在{school|B}中忍辱负重，刻苦修行…但无论我如何努力，却还始终都只是一个外门弟子…
610204.en: For years I endured strenuous training in {school|B}. But no matter how hard I tried, I've never advanced beyond Initiate...

610205.ch: 可如今就不一样了！我只要擒住了你，定能以你为挟杀死风允婼！到了那时，我{name|B}必将名扬天下！
610205.en: Things are different now! Now that I have you as hostage, I can lure Feng Yunchuo and slay him. And then I, {name|B}, will become renowned all over the world!

610208.ch: 哪来的家伙？竟敢坏我的好事！哼，我先杀了你！
610208.en: Who dares ruin my fun? I'll kill you here and now!

610211.ch: 那就好，刚才真是太危险了。

610212.ch: 可是，你伤了他…我担心他日后会寻仇…
610212.en: But you hurt him... I'm worried that he'll be back for revenge...

610213.ch: 可是，你杀了他…他的宗门恐怕不会轻易放过你…
610213.en: But you killed him... His sect won't let you off the hook that easily...

610215.ch: 我叫风里希，是风允婼的女儿…
610215.en: I'm Feng Lixi, the daughter of Feng Yunchuo.

610216.ch: 之前父亲在与正道宗门决战时，曾让我们到远处去避难，但我们却在途中遇袭…
610216.en: When Father was fighting the righteous sect members, the rest of the family rushed to hide, but we got attacked on the way.

610217.ch: 大家都在奋力抵抗，但对方人多势众，修为微末的我自然成为了他们的目标…
610217.en: We all fought hard, but there were way too many of them. And I, with the least experience out of everyone, became an easy target...

610218.ch: 还好你救了我。否则，真不知道他们会怎么对待我。
610218.en: I'm so glad you came for me. Otherwise, who knows what they'd do to me...

610219.ch: 寨子里的人，大多是以前父亲从各地中救过的人。我们虽然与常人有异，却从未行过伤天害理之事…
610219.en: Most of the members of our camp were people Father rescued from all over the world. We may be different from the average human, but we've never hurt anyone...

610220.ch: 但不知为何…人们总是把我们视作妖怪，正道修仙者更是以此为由而迫害我们。
610220.en: But, for some reason, people always called us monsters. The righteous sects were the worst—they've never stopped hunting us.

610221.ch: 随着寨中的人越来越多，我们的名声也越来越响，于是便有更多的同胞前来投靠我们。同时，也有越来越多的势力将我们视为眼中钉…
610221.en: The more members we have in our camp, the more well-known we've become. More and more of our kind joined our ranks, but more and more factions started seeing us as their sworn enemies...

610222.ch: 如今的我们，也只能偏安于云陌州的一角…但父亲常说，偏安者断不能久安，更何况我们所处的位置太过接近冥山…如若不能改变现状，同胞们定会因冥气的影响而早早死去…
610222.en: Now all we can do is live in seclusion in a corner of Yun Mo. But as Father often says, we can't hide forever. Besides, we're too close to the Nether Mountains right now. If we don't move somewhere else sooner or later, our people will al perish from the deathly aura the mountains emit...

610223.ch: 我和我的家人都生活在云陌州的西南方…
610223.en: My family and I live in southwest Yun Mo...

610224.ch: 你留在此地恐怕会有性命之忧…既然如此，不如便由我送你回去吧。
610224.en: If you stay here, your life could be in danger. Let me take you back to your home.

610225.ch: 可是…跟我在一起，你恐怕会被正道宗门给盯上的。
610225.en: But... if you travel with me, the righteous sects will see you as their enemy.

610226.ch: 我既然出手救了你，又何惧于他们？
610226.en: I've already hurt some of them in order to get to you. Why should I fear them?

610229.ch: 杀害我正道之人，还袒护妖女，今日我定要将你碎尸万段！纳命来！
610229.en: I'll rip you to shreds today for killing my sect members and consorting with this demon girl! Die!

610230.ch: 伤害我正道之人，还袒护妖女，今日我定要将你碎尸万段！纳命来！
610230.en: I'll rip you to shreds today for hurting my sect members and consorting with this demon girl! Die!

610231.en: (Feng Lixi seems to have something to say to me.)

610232.ch: 也不知道大家怎么样了…

610233.ch: 你是在担心你的家人吗？
610233.en: Are you worried about your family?

610235.ch: 他们实力强大，数个势力联手都无法奈何他们，你大可不必担心。
610235.en: They're powerful people. Not even an alliance of several factions could harm them. There's nothing to worry about.

610236.ch: 其实…正道之所以无法彻底击败我们，是因为我们的所驻之地地势险要，且周围皆是冥山，易守难攻。
610236.en: Well, actually... the real reason the righteous sects haven't been able to defeat us yet is the terrain where our camp is built. The location is surrounded by the Nether Mountains, making it strategically easy to defend.

610237.ch: 但也正因如此，大家都被冥气所影响。如此下去恐怕不是长久之计…
610237.en: But the place is also affected by the deathly aura from the mountains. We can't remain there forever...

610240.ch: 我没想到，竟有人会为了袒护妖魔而与人类对立！事已至此，今日我便要替天行道！
610240.en: I can't believe a human would dare to stand against humans for the sake of defending a demon! There's no turning back now. I shall teach you a lesson on behalf of the heavens!

610241.ch: 竟然敢闯入我们的地盘，我看你是活腻了！快快束手就擒吧！
610241.en: How dare you enter our territory? You must be asking for death. Surrender now!

610242.ch: 竟然敢闯入我们的地盘，我看你是活腻了！快快束手就擒吧！
610242.en: How dare you enter our territory? You must be asking for death. Surrender now!

610243.ch: 竟然敢闯入我们的地盘，我看你是活腻了！快快束手就擒吧！
610243.en: How dare you enter our territory? You must be asking for death. Surrender now!

610244.ch: 你们快住手！{gender|A}是我的朋友。

610245.ch: 小姐？！你回来啦！老大听说你消失后，都快疯了！
610245.en: Milady, you're home! The boss's almost gone crazy after those humans abducted you.

610246.en: Hurry back into the camp to see him!

610247.ch: 嗯，让你们担心了。我这就去找父亲。
610247.en: All right, I'm sorry for making everyone worry. I'll go see Father immediately.

610248.ch: 你既然是小姐的朋友，我也不便多说什么。但你身为人类，最好还是不要掺和我们的事。
610248.en: I'll leave you alone since you're a friend of Milady's. But I must warn you, human, to stay out of our business.

610251.en: You're back... Thank goodness you're back!

610252.en: If it weren't for {name|A} who rescued me, I would have...

610254.ch: 朋友，感谢你愿意挺身而出搭救小女。
610254.en: Thank you, friend, for helping my daughter.

610255.ch: 你千里迢迢的将里希送回来，我本该布下宴席为你们接风洗尘…却奈何寨中条件简陋，环境恶劣，望阁下见谅…
610255.en: I should've held a banquet to thank you for bringing Lixi all the way back... But our camp is a bit shabby right now, so please forgive us...

610256.ch: 老大，北边又有弟兄被冥气侵蚀了。
610256.en: Boss, some of our people have succumbed to the deathly aura in the north.

610257.ch: …这已经是第几次了？绝对不能再这样下去了！
610257.en: ...Again? How many have been affected already? This can't go on!

610259.ch: 朱老头已经稳定了他们的情况，暂时没有生命危险。
610259.en: Old Zhu has been taking care of them. Life signs are stable, and they're not currently in danger.

610260.en: If only we had the Holy Flame...

610261.ch: 老大，您还在惦记着这事呢…
610261.en: You're still thinking about that, Boss?

610262.ch: 那不过是一个传说罢了，永恒冰原中异兽无数…稍有一个不慎，那便会死无葬身之地啊！小不忍则乱大谋，小小邪气算的了什么？！若是失去了老大你，那才真的叫人绝望！
610262.en: It's just a myth... Besides, Everfrost is heavily populated with dangerous beasts. Anyone who enters will be devoured whole if not careful! Come on, a little bit of evil aura can't be that bad. If you go seeking the Holy Flame and lose your life... Now our people really won't be able to handle that!

610263.ch: 你们既已将性命托付于我，那么我身为领袖，岂能因为这点困难而驻足不前？此事我当仁不让！
610263.en: But you have all trusted me with your lives. As your leader, of course I must try my best for my people! I can't let trivial hardships hold me back.

610264.ch: 父亲，据说各大宗门每隔一段时间都会组织精英弟子到秘境中去历练。永恒冰原固然危险，可也已经有不少修仙之人从中平安归来，若是真有圣火，恐怕也已经被他们收入囊中了…
610264.en: Father, I heard that those big sects would periodically send their elite disciples out on adventures. While Everfrost may be dangerous, many disciples have been there and returned safely. Even if the Holy Flame really existed, they'd probably have taken it already...

610266.ch: 朋友，我们的情况你也已经知晓。我没有逐客的意思，但如果你长时间的停留在此处，恐怕也会与我们一样被冥气所侵蚀…
610266.en: Friend, I see you already know about our situation. While I don't want to be inhospitable, I'm afraid that if you stay for longer, you'd be affected by the deathly aura as well...

610267.ch: 若无其他要事，便尽早离去吧…我还有些事要处理，就不奉陪了。
610267.en: So if you don't have anything else to do here, you should leave as soon as you can. Anyway, I have to go now. I have some other affairs to tend to.

610268.ch: 父亲说得没错…若是在此待得久了，恐怕会遭冥气入体。
610268.en: Father is right... If you stay here for too long, you can become ill too.

610269.ch: 嗯，那我便不叨扰了，这就离开吧。
610269.en: I see. I'll take my leave then.

610270.en: Please let me see you off...

610272.ch: 如今正道势力与我们的关系越来越紧张。今日一别，不知要何时才能再见…
610272.en: The situation is dire between us and the righteous sects. I don't know if we'll ever meet again...

610273.ch: 我们都有各自的路要走，待此间事了，我们定还有再见的机缘。
610273.en: We have our own different paths to walk on. Once everyone's settled down, we might see each other again.

610277.ch: 前些日子，父亲独自离开了营寨中，他一定是到永恒冰原去了！
610277.en: Father left the camp recently on his own. We think he must be headed to Everfrost!

610278.ch: 我非常担心他的安危，你能帮我去找找他吗？
610278.en: I'm very worried about him... Could you go after him for me?

610279.ch: …传说永恒冰原中孕育着圣火，这种火焰能够净化天地间一切邪祟。寨中的同胞久受冥气入体之苦，他从很早之前就想要去冰原中寻找圣火了…
610279.en: According to legends, there's a special item called the Holy Flame that can be found in Everfrost. The flames are said to be able to purify all evil! Our people have been suffering from the deathly aura for a while, and Father has often considered going to Everfrost in search for the Holy Flame...

610281.ch: 你在冰原中找到了一棵巨大的树，在大树下找到了风允婼。
610281.en: You come a huge tree in Everfrost, with Feng Yunchuo standing at its foot.

610282.ch: 此时，周围传来了异样的响声，你们抬头看去，只见上方有数只异鸟正在树上进食。
610282.en: Suddenly, you hear a suspicious noise and glance up to see several strange birds eating atop the tree.

610283.ch: 异鸟发现了你的存在，迅速的朝你们袭来。
610283.en: Noticing you standing there, the strange birds swoop upon you.

610285.ch: …罢了，先解决眼前的麻烦吧！这些家伙似乎不好对付，你帮我牵制住这些妖兽，我来对付这个大家伙！
610285.en: ...Forget it, let's deal with what's in front of us first. These guys are tough. Please distract the monsters for me and I'll take care of the big one!

610286.ch: 最终，巨大的树木被风允婼破开了一个窟窿。
610286.en: In the end, Feng Yunchuo blasts open a hole in the giant tree.

610287.ch: 片刻后，一缕青蓝色的火焰浮现在你们眼前…
610287.en: Soon, a blue flame appears, floating, in front of you.

610288.ch: 这就是圣火的火种…真是惊人的威能，看来想要驾驭它并非易事。
610288.en: So this is the seed of the Holy Flame... I can feel it vibrating with energy. Its powers must be difficult to harness.

610289.ch: 既已取得火种，这便离开冰原吧！免得夜长梦多。
610289.en: Now that we've got what we need, let's get out of here as soon as we can.

610290.ch: 老大！我就知道你一定会平安回来的…呜呜呜…
610290.en: Boss! I knew you'd come back safely... *sobbing*

610291.ch: 哭什么哭？能不能别丢人了！
610291.en: What are you crying for? Pathetic!

610292.ch: 咱们老大可是闯荡过天元山的强者，云陌州的第一人！小小冰原，岂能困得住老大？
610292.en: Our boss has been to the legendary Tian Yuan Mountain and back. He's the first in Yun Mo to have ever done so! Everfrost is a piece of cake to him.

610294.ch: {name|A}…谢谢你将父亲平安的带回来。还有，对不起…
610294.en: Thank you, {name|A}, for bringing Father back safely. And I really must apologize...

610295.ch: 我不该任性的请求你去往永恒冰原的…若是你因此而遇害，我一定会内疚一辈子…
610295.en: I shouldn't have asked you to go to Everfrost out of my own selfish motives. If you got hurt because of that, I'd never forgive myself...

610296.ch: 不必在意…我志在远方，踏入永恒冰原是早晚的事。
610296.en: No need to worry. I have great ambitions to see the world. Everfrost is just one of my many stops.

610297.ch: 哈哈哈，说得好！修行之人志当存高远，岂能因眼前的困难而驻足？
610297.en: Ha, well said! A true cultivator must be ambitious indeed. Can't be intimidated by the tiniest obstacle.

610298.ch: 方才听说，你曾去过天元山…可否告诉我，天元山位于何处？
610298.en: So you've been to Tian Yuan Mountain? Can you tell me where it is?

610299.ch: 哦？你想要去天元山？那个地方神秘的很，你去那做什么？
610299.en: Oh? You want to go to Tian Yuan Mountain? Why? It's quite the mysterious place.

610300.ch: 罢了……不错，我多年前的确曾闯入过天元山，那个地方灵气浓郁，妖兽更是异常凶猛！危险程度可不是区区冰原可比拟的。
610300.en: Anyway, yes, I've been to Tian Yuan Mountain many years ago. A place overflowing with Qi... with monsters at every corner you turn! It's far more dangerous than Everfrost.

610301.ch: 天元山便耸立于天元中，而天元 则处于整个八荒大陆最中心的位置。
610301.en: Tian Yuan Mountain lies in Tian Yuan, located at the very center of the continent.

610302.ch: 从云陌州跨越永恒冰原，一直往西走，便能够抵达暮仙州，再从暮仙州跨越了迷途荒漠，便可以抵达赤幽州…
610302.en: Starting from Yun Mo, you have to travel across Everfrost towards the west to arrive at Mu Xian. And from there, you go through the Wayward Desert to get to Chi You.

610303.ch: 赤幽州便是前往天元的关键。具体情况，你还是到了赤幽州后寻人打听为好。
610303.en: Chi You is where you need to be if you want to get to Tian Yuan. Once you're there, you should ask around for directions to the mountain.

610304.ch: 多谢相告！那我这便出发前往暮仙州吧！
610304.en: Thanks for the tip! I'll set off to Mu Xian then.

610305.ch: {name|A}，你对我们部落相助良多，实在无以为报…日后若有所需，风某定在所不辞！
610305.en: {name|A}, you've done so much for our sect. There's really nothing we can do to repay you... But if you need anything in the future, feel free to come to me!

610306.en: {name|A}... Once you've gone to Tian Yuan... Will you ever visit us again?

610308.ch: 这样啊…但我相信，我们一定还有再见的机缘。
610308.en: I see... But I believe in destiny. We'll definitely meet again one day.

610310.ch: 唔…你好，小不点，很抱歉吓到你了。
610310.en: Oh, hello, little one. Sorry, didn't see you there.

610312.ch: 我啊？我是夸父族的族人，大家都叫我阿夸。
610312.en: Me? I'm Agar from the Kuafu Clan.

610314.ch: 我呀，我要去追那天上的太阳。
610314.en: See that sun in the sky? I'm gonna catch up with it!

610315.ch: 什么？！你为什么要追太阳？
610315.en: Huh? Why'd you want to do that?

610316.ch: 哈哈哈，没有为什么，我就是想追太阳。或许，我就是想看看它会落在何处吧…
610316.en: Heh, no particular reason... I just want to. Maybe I'm just curious where it usually sets.

610317.ch: 为何想要知道日落何处？这有什么意义吗？
610317.en: Why do you want to know where the sun sets? What's the point?

610318.ch: 这个世界上有太多的问题没有答案，而我只想解决其中一个问题。
610318.en: There are too many unanswered questions in the world. Maybe I was born to find out the answer to one of these questions.

610319.ch: 那就是太阳最终会落在哪里。
610319.en: Which is the location of the sun's setting spot.

610320.ch: 难道…你就没有想要寻找的答案吗？
